inventory.detail.title: 库存与目标明细分页
inventory.detail.notes: 日实存与目标键并集；库存缺行保持NULL，目标重复不任选；仅纠偏允许正值月初回补；滚动不回补。SKU编码精确连接，不自动去前导零。stock_date须属于month。源品类仅来自目标，不把品项当品类。目标粽子规则保留，缺日均需求不补0。目标月份不是目标采集时间。 known_*为已知值口径，须随missing_*显示部分；动销仍为源日均，不能赋给shipment30。；商品资料仅按唯一SKU匹配产品清单补空名称/物料组；同SKU字段冲突保留空，数量与日期范围不变。

:gea_p1 AND (t.inventory_version = :gea_p2 OR (:gea_p2 = '纠偏' AND t.inventory_version = '月初')) GROUP BY t.year_month, t.inventory_version, t.belong_base, t.material_code), stock_source AS (SELECT WHEN COUNT(*) = 1 THEN MAX(t.next_month_out_plan) ELSE NULL END AS next_month_out_plan, CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = 1 THEN MAX(t.next_month_sales_plan) ELSE NULL END AS next_month_sales_plan, COUNT(*) AS source_rows FROM agents_scm_stock_detail_d AS t WHERE t.data_month = CAST(:gea_p1 AS DATE) AND t.the_date = :gea_p3 GROUP BY t.data_month, t.the_date, t.belong_base, t.material_code), target_keys AS WHEN c.material_code IS NULL THEN m.current_inventory ELSE c.current_inventory END AS current_inventory, CASE WHEN :gea_p2 = '纠偏' AND (c.material_code IS NULL OR (c.source_rows = 1 AND (c.turnover_inventory IS NULL OR c.turnover_inventory <= 0))) AND m.turnover_inventory > 0 THEN m.turnover_inventory WHEN c.material_code IS NULL THEN m.turnover_inventory ELSE c.turnover_inventory END AS turnover_inventory, CASE WHEN :gea_p2 = '纠偏' AND (c.material_code IS NULL OR (c.source_rows = 1 AND (c.safety_stock IS NULL OR c.safety_stock <= 0))) AND m.safety_stock > 0 THEN m.safety_stock c.avg_daily_planned_demand END AS avg_daily_planned_demand, CASE WHEN :gea_p2 = '纠偏' AND (c.material_code IS NULL OR (c.source_rows = 1 AND (c.target_inventory IS NULL OR c.target_inventory <= 0))) IS NULL OR (c.source_rows = 1 AND (c.management_target_inventory IS NULL OR c.management_target_inventory <= 0))) AND m.management_target_inventory > 0 THEN m.management_target_inventory WHEN c.material_code IS NULL THEN m.management_target_inventory ELSE c.management_target_inventory END AS management_target_inventory, CASE WHEN :gea_p2 = '纠偏' AND (c.material_code IS NULL OR (c.source_rows = 1 AND (c.final_target_inventory IS NULL OR c.final_target_inventory <= 0))) AND m.final_target_inventory > 0 THEN m.final_target_inventory WHEN c.material_code IS NULL THEN m.final_target_inventory ELSE c.final_target_inventory END AS final_target_inventory, CASE WHEN :gea_p2 = '纠偏' AND (c.material_code IS NULL OR (c.source_rows = 1 AND (c.current_turnover_days IS NULL OR c.current_turnover_days <= 0))) AND m.current_turnover_days > 0 THEN m.current_turnover_days WHEN c.material_code IS NULL THEN m.current_turnover_days ELSE c.current_turnover_days END AS current_turnover_days, CASE WHEN :gea_p2 = '纠偏' AND (c.material_code IS NULL OR (c.source_rows = 1 AND (c.target_fill_rate IS NULL OR c.target_fill_rate <= 0))) AND m.target_fill_rate > 0 THEN AS avg_30d_sale, CASE WHEN c.material_code IS NULL THEN m.source_rows ELSE c.source_rows END AS target_rows FROM target_keys AS k LEFT JOIN target_source AS c ON c.belong_base = k.base AND c.material_code = k.sku AND c.inventory_version = :gea_p2 LEFT JOIN target_source AS m ON m.belong_base = k.base AND m.material_code = k.sku AND m.inventory_version = '月初' AND :gea_p2 = '纠偏'), inventory_keys AS (SELECT t.base AS base, t.sku AS sku FROM targets AS t UNION ALL SELECT s.belong_base AS base, s.material_code AS sku FROM stock_source AS s LEFT JOIN targets AS t ON t.base = s.belong_base AND t.sku = s.material_code WHERE t.sku IS NULL), aligned AS (SELECT k.base AS base, k.sku AS sku, :gea_p1 AS month, :gea_p3 AS stock_date, t.effective_version AS effective_version, COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(COALESCE(s.material_name, t.material_name)), ''), pm.material_name) AS material_name, COALESCE(NULLIF(t.product_categ_name, ''), d.category) AS category, COALESCE(NULLIF(s.product_item, ''), d.item) AS item, s.series AS series, s.channel_name AS channel, t.product_tag AS product_tag, s.current_stock AS inventory, s.available_stock AS available, s.current_stock_60 AS over60, t.avg_daily_planned_demand AS daily_demand, t.safety_stock AS safety_stock, t.turnover_inventory AS turnover_inventory, t.target_inventory AS initial_target, t.management_target_inventory AS management_target, t.final_target_inventory AS final_target, CASE WHEN t.sku IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN t.product_categ_name = '粽子' OR t.product_tag LIKE '%粽子%' OR t.material_name LIKE '%粽子%' THEN CASE WHEN t.avg_daily_planned_demand IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN t.avg_daily_planned_demand > 0 THEN t.turnover_inventory ELSE 0 END ELSE t.final_target_inventory END AS target, t.avg_30d_sale AS target_avg_30d_sale, s.avg_30d_sale AS stock_avg_30d_sale, s.allocated_qty AS allocated, s.ordered_qty AS ordered, COALESCE(t.target_rows, 0) AS target_source_rows, COALESCE(s.source_rows, 0) AS stock_source_rows FROM inventory_keys AS k LEFT JOIN targets AS t ON t.base = k.base AND t.sku = k.sku LEFT JOIN stock_source AS s ON s.belong_base = k.base AND s.material_code = k.sku LEFT JOIN material_dictionary AS d ON d.sku = k.sku LEFT JOIN product_list_dictionary AS pm ON pm.sku = k.sku), business_rows AS (SELECT a.base AS base, a.sku AS sku, a.month AS month, a.stock_date AS stock_date, a.effective_version AS effective_version, a.material_name AS material_name, a.category AS category, a.item AS item, a.series AS series, a.channel AS channel, a.product_tag AS product_tag, a.inventory AS inventory, a.available AS available, a.over60 AS over60, a.daily_demand AS daily_demand, a.safety_stock AS safety_stock, a.turnover_inventory AS turnover_inventory, a.initial_target AS initial_target, a.management_target AS management_target, a.final_target AS final_target, a.target AS target, a.target_avg_30d_sale AS target_avg_30d_sale, a.stock_avg_30d_sale AS stock_avg_30d_sale, a.allocated AS allocated, a.ordered AS ordered, a.target_source_rows AS target_source_rows, a.stock_source_rows AS stock_source_rows, a.inventory - a.target AS gap, CASE WHEN a.inventory IS NULL OR a.target IS NULL THEN 'unknown' WHEN a.inventory < a.target THEN 'low' WHEN a.inventory > a.target THEN 'high' ELSE 'normal' END AS risk FROM aligned AS a), filtered AS (SELECT r.base AS base, r.sku AS sku, r.month AS month, r.stock_date AS stock_date, r.effective_version AS effective_version, r.material_name AS material_name, r.category AS category, r.item AS item, r.series AS series, r.channel AS channel, r.product_tag AS product_tag, r.inventory AS inventory, r.available AS available, r.over60 AS over60, r.daily_demand AS daily_demand, r.safety_stock AS safety_stock, r.turnover_inventory AS turnover_inventory, r.initial_target AS initial_target, r.management_target AS management_target, r.final_target AS final_target, r.target AS target, r.target_avg_30d_sale AS target_avg_30d_sale, r.stock_avg_30d_sale AS stock_avg_30d_sale, r.allocated AS allocated, r.ordered AS ordered, r.target_source_rows AS target_source_rows, r.stock_source_rows AS stock_source_rows, r.gap AS gap, r.risk AS risk FROM business_rows AS r WHERE (:gea_p4 = FALSE OR r.base IN (:gea_p5)) AND (:gea_p6 = 'all' OR (:gea_p6 = 'equal' AND r.sku = :gea_p7) OR (:gea_p6 = 'missing' AND r.sku IS NULL)) AND (:gea_p8 = 'all' OR (:gea_p8 = 'equal' AND r.category = :gea_p9) OR (:gea_p8 = 'missing' AND r.category IS NULL)) AND (:gea_p10 = 'all' OR (:gea_p10 = 'equal' AND r.item = :gea_p11) OR (:gea_p10 = 'missing' AND r.item IS NULL)) AND (:gea_p12 = 'all' OR (:gea_p12 = 'equal' AND r.series = :gea_p13) OR (:gea_p12 = 'missing' AND r.series IS NULL)) AND (:gea_p14 = 'all' OR (:gea_p14 = 'equal' AND r.channel = :gea_p15) OR (:gea_p14 = 'missing' AND r.channel IS NULL)) AND (:gea_p16 = 'all' OR (:gea_p16 = 'equal' AND r.risk = :gea_p17) OR (:gea_p16 = 'missing' AND r.risk IS NULL)) AND (:gea_p18 IS NULL OR LOWER(r.sku) LIKE LOWER(:gea_p18) OR LOWER(r.material_name) LIKE LOWER(:gea_p18) OR LOWER(r.category) LIKE LOWER(:gea_p18)) AND (:gea_p19 IS NULL OR r.category IS NULL OR r.category <> :gea_p19)) SELECT r.base AS base, r.sku AS sku, r.month AS month, r.stock_date AS stock_date, r.effective_version AS effective_version, r.material_name AS material_name, r.category AS category, r.item AS item, r.series AS series, r.channel AS channel, r.product_tag AS product_tag, r.inventory AS inventory, r.available AS available, r.over60 AS over60, r.daily_demand AS daily_demand, r.safety_stock AS safety_stock, r.turnover_inventory AS turnover_inventory, r.initial_target AS initial_target, r.management_target AS management_target, r.final_target AS final_target, r.target AS target, r.target_avg_30d_sale AS target_avg_30d_sale, r.stock_avg_30d_sale AS stock_avg_30d_sale, r.allocated AS allocated, r.ordered AS ordered, r.target_source_rows AS target_source_rows, r.stock_source_rows AS stock_source_rows, r.gap AS gap, r.risk AS risk FROM filtered AS r ORDER BY CASE WHEN :gea_p22 = 'gap' AND r.gap IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ASC, CASE WHEN :gea_p22 = 'gap' AND :gea_p23 = 'asc' THEN r.gap ELSE NULL END ASC, CASE WHEN :gea_p22 = 'gap' AND :gea_p23 = 'desc' THEN r.gap ELSE NULL END DESC, CASE WHEN :gea_p22 = 'inventory' AND r.inventory IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ASC, CASE WHEN :gea_p22 = 'inventory' AND :gea_p23 = 'asc' THEN r.inventory ELSE NULL END ASC, CASE WHEN :gea_p22 = 'inventory' AND :gea_p23 = 'desc' THEN r.inventory ELSE NULL END DESC, CASE WHEN :gea_p22 = 'target' AND r.target IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ASC, CASE WHEN :gea_p22 = 'target' AND :gea_p23 = 'asc' THEN r.target ELSE NULL END ASC, CASE WHEN :gea_p22 = 'target' AND :gea_p23 = 'desc' THEN r.target ELSE NULL END DESC, CASE WHEN :gea_p22 = 'safety_stock' AND r.safety_stock IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ASC, CASE WHEN :gea_p22 = 'safety_stock' AND :gea_p23 = 'asc' THEN r.safety_stock ELSE NULL END ASC, CASE WHEN :gea_p22 = 'safety_stock' AND :gea_p23 = 'desc' THEN r.safety_stock ELSE NULL END DESC, CASE WHEN :gea_p22 = 'turnover_inventory' AND r.turnover_inventory IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ASC, CASE WHEN :gea_p22 = 'turnover_inventory' AND :gea_p23 = 'asc' THEN r.turnover_inventory ELSE NULL END ASC, CASE WHEN :gea_p22 = 'turnover_inventory' AND :gea_p23 = 'desc' THEN r.turnover_inventory ELSE NULL END DESC, r.base ASC, r.sku ASC LIMIT :gea_p20 OFFSET :gea_p21

inventory.summary.title: 库存与目标全范围汇总
inventory.summary.notes: 日实存与目标键并集；库存缺行保持NULL，目标重复不任选；仅纠偏允许正值月初回补；滚动不回补。SKU编码精确连接，不自动去前导零。stock_date须属于month。源品类仅来自目标，不把品项当品类。目标粽子规则保留，缺日均需求不补0。目标月份不是目标采集时间。 known_*为已知值口径，须随missing_*显示部分；动销仍为源日均，不能赋给shipment30。 汇总不受列表分页参数影响。 基地库存快照的未备单量和已备单占用量独立汇总，保留快照SKU范围；两者不相加、不代替全链当前待发或订单阶段事实。；商品资料仅按唯一SKU匹配产品清单补空名称/物料组；同SKU字段冲突保留空，数量与日期范围不变。

inventory.groups.title: 库存与目标分层汇总分页
inventory.groups.notes: 日实存与目标键并集；库存缺行保持NULL，目标重复不任选；仅纠偏允许正值月初回补；滚动不回补。SKU编码精确连接，不自动去前导零。stock_date须属于month。源品类仅来自目标，不把品项当品类。目标粽子规则保留，缺日均需求不补0。目标月份不是目标采集时间。 known_*为已知值口径，须随missing_*显示部分；动销仍为源日均，不能赋给shipment30。；商品资料仅按唯一SKU匹配产品清单补空名称/物料组；同SKU字段冲突保留空，数量与日期范围不变。 批次现库存按仓库/SKU求和；不按 warehouse_classify 过滤或归类；分仓用 warehouseid 编码关联和筛选、warehouse_name 展示名称；基地用 belong_base 名称关联和筛选；商品名称取 material_name；基地与分仓为同一事实集的维度，不重复相加；正库存且生产日期有效的批次计算最大货龄。源已移除超龄阈值标志、安全/目标库存及更新时间，保持未知。

inventory.groups_count.notes: 日实存与目标键并集；库存缺行保持NULL，目标重复不任选；仅纠偏允许正值月初回补；滚动不回补。SKU编码精确连接，不自动去前导零。stock_date须属于month。源品类仅来自目标，不把品项当品类。目标粽子规则保留，缺日均需求不补0。目标月份不是目标采集时间。 known_*为已知值口径，须随missing_*显示部分；动销仍为源日均，不能赋给shipment30。；商品资料仅按唯一SKU匹配产品清单补空名称/物料组；同SKU字段冲突保留空，数量与日期范围不变。

inventory.options.title: 库存与目标级联筛选选项
inventory.options.notes: 日实存与目标键并集；库存缺行保持NULL，目标重复不任选；仅纠偏允许正值月初回补；滚动不回补。SKU编码精确连接，不自动去前导零。stock_date须属于month。源品类仅来自目标，不把品项当品类。目标粽子规则保留，缺日均需求不补0。目标月份不是目标采集时间。 known_*为已知值口径，须随missing_*显示部分；动销仍为源日均，不能赋给shipment30。 取某字段选项时将该字段筛选mode置all，保留父级条件；NULL也是一个选项。；商品资料仅按唯一SKU匹配产品清单补空名称/物料组；同SKU字段冲突保留空，数量与日期范围不变。

WHERE NOT NULLIF(TRIM(t.material_code), '') IS NULL GROUP BY t.material_code), business_rows AS (SELECT t.stat_date AS stat_date, CASE WHEN COUNT(t.belong_base) = COUNT(*) AND COUNT(DISTINCT t.belong_base) = 1 THEN MAX(t.belong_base) ELSE NULL END AS belong_base, CASE WHEN COUNT(t.warehouse_type) = COUNT(*) AND COUNT(DISTINCT t.warehouse_type) = 1 THEN MAX(t.warehouse_type) ELSE NULL END AS warehouse_type, CASE WHEN COUNT(t.product_categ_name) = COUNT(*) AND COUNT(DISTINCT t.product_categ_name) = 1 THEN MAX(t.product_categ_name) ELSE NULL END AS product_categ_name, CASE WHEN COUNT(t.age_days) = COUNT(*) AND COUNT(DISTINCT t.age_days) = 1 THEN MAX(t.age_days) ELSE NULL END AS age_days, CASE WHEN COUNT(t.available_qty) = COUNT(*) AND COUNT(DISTINCT t.available_qty) = 1 THEN health.count.title: 源库存健康度筛选后总数
health.count.notes: 按统计日/基地/仓库类型/仓库编码/SKU读取；同键重复保留NULL。total_qty用于仓库库存范围；current_stock、target_stock_qty为跨仓重复的基地SKU参考值，不逐仓相加。货龄采用同记录total_qty加权，不推演批次。 批次现库存按仓库/SKU求和；不按 warehouse_classify 过滤或归类；分仓用 warehouseid 编码关联和筛选、warehouse_name 展示名称；基地用 belong_base 名称关联和筛选；商品名称取 material_name；基地与分仓为同一事实集的维度，不重复相加；正库存且生产日期有效的批次计算最大货龄。源已移除超龄阈值标志、安全/目标库存及更新时间，保持未知。

health.summary.notes: 按统计日/基地/仓库类型/仓库编码/SKU读取；同键重复保留NULL。total_qty用于仓库库存范围；current_stock、target_stock_qty为跨仓重复的基地SKU参考值，不逐仓相加。货龄采用同记录total_qty加权，不推演批次。；全链卡片基地货龄取基地仓最大库龄，保留分仓独立快照；不把最大值当平均货龄。 批次现库存按仓库/SKU求和；不按 warehouse_classify 过滤或归类；分仓用 warehouseid 编码关联和筛选、warehouse_name 展示名称；基地用 belong_base 名称关联和筛选；商品名称取 material_name；基地与分仓为同一事实集的维度，不重复相加；正库存且生产日期有效的批次计算最大货龄。源已移除超龄阈值标志、安全/目标库存及更新时间，保持未知。

health.options.title: 源库存健康度级联筛选选项
health.options.notes: 按统计日/基地/仓库类型/仓库编码/SKU读取；同键重复保留NULL。total_qty用于仓库库存范围；current_stock、target_stock_qty为跨仓重复的基地SKU参考值，不逐仓相加。货龄采用同记录total_qty加权，不推演批次。 批次现库存按仓库/SKU求和；不按 warehouse_classify 过滤或归类；分仓用 warehouseid 编码关联和筛选、warehouse_name 展示名称；基地用 belong_base 名称关联和筛选；商品名称取 material_name；基地与分仓为同一事实集的维度，不重复相加；正库存且生产日期有效的批次计算最大货龄。源已移除超龄阈值标志、安全/目标库存及更新时间，保持未知。

inventory.groups.atomic.title: 库存与目标分层汇总分页
inventory.groups.atomic.notes: 同一SQL读取总数及当前页；空页用一条标记行保留总数；外层显式保持原排序，不下载全量明细。；商品资料仅按唯一SKU匹配产品清单补空名称/物料组；同SKU字段冲突保留空，数量与日期范围不变。 批次现库存按仓库/SKU求和；不按 warehouse_classify 过滤或归类；分仓用 warehouseid 编码关联和筛选、warehouse_name 展示名称；基地用 belong_base 名称关联和筛选；商品名称取 material_name；基地与分仓为同一事实集的维度，不重复相加；正库存且生产日期有效的批次计算最大货龄。源已移除超龄阈值标志、安全/目标库存及更新时间，保持未知。

(d.production_year - CASE WHEN d.production_month <= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) + FLOOR((d.production_year - CASE WHEN d.production_month <= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / 4.0) - FLOOR((d.production_year - CASE location_type, o.warehouseid AS warehouseid, o.material_code AS material_code FROM eligible_order_sku AS o GROUP BY o.location_type, o.warehouseid, o.material_code), source_records AS (SELECT t.stat_month = SUBSTRING(REPLACE(CAST(:gea_p2300 AS VARCHAR(10)), '-', ''), 1, 6) GROUP BY t.warehouse_code, t.material_code), branch_stock_keys AS (SELECT b.warehouseid AS warehouseid, b.material_code AS material_code FROM agents_scm_inventory_sku_data_d AS b WHERE b.warehouse_classify = '20' AND b.month_date = REPLACE(CAST(:gea_p2200 AS VARCHAR(10)), '-', '') GROUP BY b.warehouseid, b.material_code), source_keys AS (SELECT s.warehouse_code AS warehouse_code, s.material_code AS material_code FROM source_records AS s UNION ALL SELECT h.warehouseid AS warehouse_code, h.material_code AS material_code FROM branch_stock_keys AS h WHERE NOT NULLIF(TRIM(h.warehouseid), '') IS NULL UNION ALL SELECT co.warehouseid AS warehouse_code, co.material_code AS material_code FROM fc_order_keys AS co WHERE co.location_type = '分仓' AND NOT co.material_code IS NULL AND NOT co.warehouseid IS NULL), scope_keys AS (SELECT k.warehouse_code AS warehouse_code, k.material_code AS material_code FROM source_keys AS k GROUP BY k.warehouse_code, k.material_code), inventory_batch_dates AS (SELECT b.warehouseid AS warehouseid, b.material_code AS material_code, b.month_date AS month_date, b.warehouse_name AS warehouse_name, b.material_name AS material_name FROM agents_scm_inventory_sku_data_d AS b WHERE b.warehouse_classify = '20' AND b.month_date = REPLACE(CAST(:gea_p2200 AS VARCHAR(10)), '-', '')), inventory_batch_ages AS (SELECT d.warehouseid AS warehouseid, d.material_code AS material_code, d.month_date AS month_date, d.warehouse_name AS warehouse_name, d.material_name AS material_name FROM inventory_batch_dates AS d), inventory_batch_totals AS (SELECT CAST(CONCAT(COALESCE(SUBSTRING(a.month_date, 1, 4), ''), '-', COALESCE(SUBSTRING(a.month_date, 5, 2), ''), '-', COALESCE(SUBSTRING(a.month_date, 7, 2), '')) AS DATE) AS stat_date, a.warehouseid AS warehouseid, a.material_code AS material_code, CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT NULLIF(TRIM(a.warehouse_name), '')) = 1 THEN MAX(NULLIF(TRIM(a.warehouse_name), '')) ELSE NULL END AS warehouse_name, CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT NULLIF(TRIM(a.material_name), '')) = 1 THEN MAX(NULLIF(TRIM(a.material_name), '')) ELSE NULL END AS material_name FROM inventory_batch_ages AS a GROUP BY a.month_date, a.warehouseid, a.material_code), inventory_batch_names AS (SELECT n.warehouseid AS warehouseid, n.material_code AS material_code, CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT NULLIF(n.product_categ_name, '')) = 1 THEN MAX(NULLIF(n.product_categ_name, '')) ELSE NULL END AS product_categ_name FROM agents_scm_material_in_out_summary_d AS n GROUP BY n.warehouseid, n.material_code), inventory_batch_source AS (SELECT a.stat_date AS stat_date, a.warehouseid AS warehouseid, a.material_code AS material_code, COALESCE(a.warehouse_name, a.warehouseid) AS warehouse_name, a.material_name AS material_name, n.product_categ_name AS product_categ_name FROM inventory_batch_totals AS a LEFT JOIN inventory_batch_names AS n ON n.warehouseid = a.warehouseid AND n.material_code = a.material_code), branch_stock AS (SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(t.product_categ_name) = COUNT(*) AND COUNT(t.warehouse_name) = COUNT(*) AND COUNT(DISTINCT t.warehouse_name) = 1 THEN MAX(t.warehouse_name) ELSE NULL END AS warehouse_name, CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT NULLIF(TRIM(t.material_name), '')) = 1 THEN MAX(NULLIF(TRIM(t.material_name), '')) ELSE NULL END AS material_name FROM inventory_batch_source AS t WHERE t.stat_date = CAST(:gea_p2200 AS DATE) GROUP BY t.stat_date, t.warehouseid, t.material_code), branch_shipments AS (SELECT t.warehouse AS warehouse_code, t.material_code AS sku, CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT NULLIF(t.material_name, '')) = 1 THEN MAX(NULLIF(t.material_name, '')) ELSE NULL END AS material_name, CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT NULLIF(t.product_categ_name, '')) = 1 THEN MAX(NULLIF(t.product_categ_name, '')) ELSE NULL END AS category FROM agents_scm_cust_deliv_daily_di (r.available_qty - r.fc_remaining_orders) - r.open_transfer_reported_qty) ELSE 0 END AS recommended_qty, CASE WHEN r.available_qty IS NULL OR r.fc_remaining_orders IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN (r.available_qty - r.fc_remaining_orders) < 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS urgent, CASE WHEN r.plan_calculable <> 1 THEN NULL WHEN r.month_out_plan = 0 THEN 0 WHEN r.month_ship_positive IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN r.month_out_plan > r.month_ship_positive THEN r.month_out_plan - r.month_ship_positive ELSE 0 END AS remaining_outbound_qty, r.fc_daily AS calculation_daily, CASE WHEN (CASE WHEN (:gea_p2800 > 0 AND r.fc_daily IS NULL) OR (30 - :gea_p2800 > 0 AND r.fc_next_daily IS NULL) THEN NULL ELSE CEIL((COALESCE(r.fc_daily, 0) * :gea_p2800 + COALESCE(r.fc_next_daily, 0) * (30 - :gea_p2800)) / 30.0) END) IS NULL OR r.available_qty IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN (r.fc_cycle + CAST(:gea_p2304 AS INT)) * (CASE WHEN (:gea_p2800 > 0 AND r.fc_daily IS NULL) OR (30 - :gea_p2800 > 0 AND r.fc_next_daily IS NULL) THEN NULL ELSE CEIL((COALESCE(r.fc_daily, 0) * :gea_p2800 + COALESCE(r.fc_next_daily, 0) * (30 - :gea_p2800)) / 30.0) END) - r.available_qty > 0 THEN (r.fc_cycle + CAST(:gea_p2304 AS INT)) * (CASE WHEN (:gea_p2800 > 0 AND r.fc_daily IS NULL) OR (30 - :gea_p2800 > 0 AND r.fc_next_daily IS NULL) THEN NULL ELSE CEIL((COALESCE(r.fc_daily, 0) * :gea_p2800 + COALESCE(r.fc_next_daily, 0) * (30 - :gea_p2800)) / 30.0) END) - r.available_qty ELSE 0 END AS target_gap_qty FROM fc_net_input AS r), filtered AS (SELECT r.warehouse_code AS warehouse_code, r.inventory_qty AS inventory_qty, r.available_qty AS available_qty, r.occupied_qty AS occupied_qty, r.frozen_qty AS frozen_qty, r.stock_present AS stock_present, r.plan_present AS plan_present, r.preparing_present AS preparing_present, r.in_transit_present AS in_transit_present, r.daily_plan AS daily_plan, r.open_transfer_reported_qty AS open_transfer_reported_qty, r.in_transit AS in_transit, r.preparing AS preparing, r.month_ship_positive AS month_ship_positive, r.rolling_ship_positive AS rolling_ship_positive, r.rolling_ship_daily AS rolling_ship_daily, r.plan_calculable AS plan_calculable, r.target_inventory_qty AS target_inventory_qty, r.recommended_qty AS recommended_qty, r.urgent AS urgent, r.remaining_outbound_qty AS remaining_outbound_qty, r.calculation_daily AS calculation_daily, r.target_gap_qty AS target_gap_qty FROM measured AS r WHERE (:gea_p1 = 'all' OR (:gea_p1 = 'equal' AND r.warehouse_code = :gea_p2) OR (:gea_p1 = 'missing' AND r.warehouse_code IS NULL)) AND (:gea_p3 = 'all' OR (:gea_p3 = 'equal' AND r.sku = :gea_p4) OR (:gea_p3 = 'missing' AND r.sku IS NULL)) AND (:gea_p5 = 'all' OR (:gea_p5 = 'equal' AND r.category = :gea_p6) OR (:gea_p5 = 'missing' AND r.category IS NULL)) AND (:gea_p7 IS NULL OR LOWER(r.sku) LIKE LOWER(:gea_p7) OR LOWER(r.material_name) LIKE LOWER(:gea_p7) OR LOWER(r.warehouse_name) LIKE LOWER(:gea_p7))) SELECT COUNT(*) AS row_count, COUNT(DISTINCT r.warehouse_code) AS warehouse_count, SUM(r.stock_present) AS stock_count, SUM(r.plan_present) AS plan_count, SUM(CASE WHEN r.stock_present = 1 AND r.plan_present = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stock_only_count, SUM(r.inventory_qty) AS inventory_qty, CASE WHEN COUNT(r.available_qty) = COUNT(*) THEN SUM(r.available_qty) ELSE NULL END AS available_qty, SUM(r.occupied_qty) AS occupied_qty, SUM(r.frozen_qty) AS frozen_qty, SUM(r.preparing) AS known_preparing, SUM(r.preparing_present) AS known_preparing_count, SUM(r.in_transit) AS known_in_transit, SUM(r.in_transit_present) AS known_in_transit_count, CASE WHEN COUNT(r.recommended_qty) = COUNT(*) THEN SUM(r.recommended_qty) ELSE NULL END AS recommended_qty, SUM(CASE WHEN r.recommended_qty > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS replenishment_sku_count, SUM(COALESCE(r.urgent, 0)) AS urgent_sku_count, SUM(r.preparing) AS preparing, SUM(r.in_transit) AS in_transit, SUM(r.open_transfer_reported_qty) AS open_transfer_reported_qty, SUM(r.rolling_ship_positive) AS rolling_ship_positive, SUM(r.month_ship_positive) AS month_ship_positive, SUM(r.rolling_ship_daily) AS rolling_ship_daily, SUM(r.plan_calculable) AS plan_calculable_count, CASE WHEN COUNT(r.remaining_outbound_qty) = COUNT(*) THEN SUM(r.remaining_outbound_qty) ELSE NULL END AS remaining_outbound_qty, SUM(CASE WHEN r.rolling_ship_daily > 0 THEN r.available_qty ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN r.rolling_ship_daily > 0 THEN r.rolling_ship_daily ELSE 0 END), 0) AS historical_turnover_days, SUM(CASE WHEN r.rolling_ship_daily > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS turnover_count, SUM(CASE WHEN r.plan_calculable = 0 AND r.rolling_ship_daily > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS historical_basis_count, SUM(CASE WHEN r.plan_calculable = 0 AND r.rolling_ship_daily = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS no_demand_count, CASE WHEN COUNT(r.target_inventory_qty) = COUNT(*) THEN SUM(r.target_inventory_qty) ELSE NULL END AS target_inventory_qty, CASE WHEN COUNT(r.calculation_daily) = COUNT(*) THEN SUM(r.calculation_daily) ELSE NULL END AS calculation_daily, CASE WHEN COUNT(r.target_gap_qty) = COUNT(*) THEN SUM(r.target_gap_qty) ELSE NULL END AS target_gap_qty, COUNT(*) - COUNT(r.recommended_qty) AS missing_calculation_count, CASE WHEN COUNT(r.daily_plan) = COUNT(*) AND COUNT(r.inventory_qty) = COUNT(*) THEN SUM(r.inventory_qty) / NULLIF(SUM(r.daily_plan), 0) ELSE NULL END AS forecast_turnover_days FROM filtered AS r

location_type, CASE WHEN i.warehouse_classify = '20' THEN i.warehouseid ELSE i.belong_base END AS location_code, CASE WHEN i.warehouse_classify = '20' THEN i.warehouse_name ELSE i.belong_base END AS SUM(COALESCE(o.qtyallocated, 0)) > 0 THEN SUM(COALESCE(o.adjust_order_qty, 0)) - SUM(COALESCE(o.qtyallocated, 0)) ELSE 0 END AS remaining_qty, MAX(CASE WHEN m.pickup_point IS NULL OR NULLIF(TRIM(o.cust_order_no), '') IS NULL OR NULLIF(TRIM(o.material_code), '') IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS input_invalid FROM agents_scm_execute_detail_d AS o LEFT JOIN point_locations AS m ON o.pickup_point = m.pickup_point WHERE o.bizflowstatus IN ('等待组波', '组波中', '组波完成', '组波失败', '提交成功', '提交中', '提交失败', '上传验证', '人工释放占用', '撤回待改单', '创建') AND (NOT m.pickup_point IS NULL OR NOT NULLIF(TRIM(o.belong_base), '') IS NULL) GROUP BY o.cust_order_no, o.material_code, CASE WHEN m.pickup_point IS NULL THEN '待映射' ELSE m.location_type END, CASE WHEN m.pickup_point IS NULL THEN CONCAT('unmapped:', COALESCE(COALESCE(o.pickup_point, 'NULL'), '')) ELSE m.location_code END), fc_order_keys AS (SELECT o.location_type AS location_type, o.warehouseid AS warehouseid, o.material_code MAX(t.product_categ_name) ELSE NULL END AS product_categ_name, CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = 1 THEN MAX(t.warehouse_month_out_plan) ELSE NULL END AS warehouse_month_out_plan, CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = 1 THEN MAX(t.stat_month) ELSE NULL END AS stat_month, '分仓同步表' AS plan_source, CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL(20, 6)) AS warehouse_month_transfer_plan, COUNT(*) AS source_rows, CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = 1 THEN agents_scm_warehouse_transfer_plan_data_d AS t WHERE t.stat_month = SUBSTRING(REPLACE(CAST(:gea_p2300 AS VARCHAR(10)), '-', '') FROM 1 FOR 6) GROUP BY t.warehouse_code, t.material_code), REPLACE(CAST(:gea_p2200 AS VARCHAR(10)), '-', '') GROUP BY b.warehouseid, b.material_code), source_keys AS (SELECT s.warehouse_code AS warehouse_code, s.material_code AS material_code FROM warehouseid, b.material_code AS material_code, b.month_date AS month_date, b.warehouse_name AS warehouse_name, b.material_name AS material_name, b.live_qty AS live_qty, b.available_qty AS available_qty, b.pack_unit_qty AS pack_unit_qty, b.freeze_qty AS freeze_qty, CAST(SUBSTRING(b.month_date FROM 1 FOR 4) AS INT) AS snapshot_year, CAST(SUBSTRING(b.month_date FROM 5 FOR 2) AS INT) AS FLOOR((d.snapshot_year - CASE WHEN d.snapshot_month <= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / 400.0) + FLOOR((153 * (d.snapshot_month + CASE WHEN d.snapshot_month > 2 THEN -3 ELSE 9 END) + 2) / 5.0) + d.snapshot_day) WITH latest_inventory AS (
  SELECT
    MAX(agents_scm_inventory_sku_data_d.month_date) AS month_date
  FROM agents_scm_inventory_sku_data_d AS agents_scm_inventory_sku_data_d
  WHERE
    agents_scm_inventory_sku_data_d.warehouse_classify IN ('01', '02', '20')
), warehouse_points AS (
  SELECT
    agents_scm_material_in_out_summary_d.warehouseid AS warehouseid,
    CASE
      WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT NULLIF(TRIM(agents_scm_material_in_out_summary_d.pickup_point), '')) = 1
      THEN MAX(NULLIF(TRIM(agents_scm_material_in_out_summary_d.pickup_point), ''))
    END AS pickup_point
  FROM agents_scm_material_in_out_summary_d AS agents_scm_material_in_out_summary_d
  GROUP BY
    agents_scm_material_in_out_summary_d.warehouseid
), inventory_rows AS (
  SELECT
    i.month_date AS month_date,
    i.warehouseid AS warehouseid,
    i.warehouse_name AS warehouse_name,
    i.belong_base AS belong_base,
    i.material_code AS material_code,
    i.material_name AS material_name,
    i.prod_date AS prod_date,
    i.sap_warehouseid AS sap_warehouseid,
    i.plant AS plant,
    i.quality_batch AS quality_batch,
    i.is_good_prod AS is_good_prod,
    i.warehouse_classify AS warehouse_classify,
    i.available_qty AS available_qty,
    w.pickup_point AS pickup_point,
    CASE WHEN i.warehouse_classify = '20' THEN '分仓' ELSE '基地' END AS location_type,
    CASE WHEN i.warehouse_classify = '20' THEN i.warehouseid ELSE i.belong_base END AS location_code,
    CASE WHEN i.warehouse_classify = '20' THEN i.warehouse_name ELSE i.belong_base END AS location_name
  FROM agents_scm_inventory_sku_data_d AS i
  INNER JOIN latest_inventory AS s
    ON i.month_date = s.month_date
  LEFT JOIN warehouse_points AS w
    ON i.warehouseid = w.warehouseid
  WHERE
    i.warehouse_classify IN ('01', '02', '20')
), point_location_candidates AS (
  SELECT
    inventory_rows.pickup_point AS pickup_point,
    inventory_rows.location_type AS location_type,
    inventory_rows.location_code AS location_code,
    MAX(inventory_rows.location_name) AS location_name,
    MAX(inventory_rows.belong_base) AS belong_base,
    CASE
      WHEN inventory_rows.location_type = '分仓'
      THEN MAX(inventory_rows.warehouseid)
    END AS warehouseid,
    COUNT(DISTINCT inventory_rows.location_name) AS name_count,
    COUNT(DISTINCT inventory_rows.belong_base) AS base_count
  FROM inventory_rows AS inventory_rows
  WHERE
    NOT inventory_rows.pickup_point IS NULL
    AND NOT NULLIF(TRIM(inventory_rows.location_code), '') IS NULL
  GROUP BY
    inventory_rows.pickup_point,
    inventory_rows.location_type,
    inventory_rows.location_code
), point_locations AS (
  SELECT
    point_location_candidates.pickup_point AS pickup_point,
    MAX(point_location_candidates.location_type) AS location_type,
    MAX(point_location_candidates.location_code) AS location_code,
    MAX(point_location_candidates.location_name) AS location_name,
    MAX(point_location_candidates.belong_base) AS belong_base,
    MAX(point_location_candidates.warehouseid) AS warehouseid
  FROM point_location_candidates AS point_location_candidates
  GROUP BY
    point_location_candidates.pickup_point
  HAVING
    COUNT(*) = 1
    AND MAX(point_location_candidates.name_count) = 1
    AND MAX(point_location_candidates.base_count) = 1

  SELECT
    o.cust_order_no AS cust_order_no,
    o.material_code AS material_code,

    CASE
      WHEN m.pickup_point IS NULL
      THEN CONCAT('unmapped:', COALESCE(o.pickup_point, 'NULL'))
      ELSE m.location_code

    MAX(COALESCE(m.location_name, o.pickup_point_name)) AS location_name,
    MAX(COALESCE(m.belong_base, o.belong_base)) AS belong_base,
    MAX(m.warehouseid) AS warehouseid,
    CASE
      WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT NULLIF(TRIM(o.material_name), '')) = 1
      THEN MAX(NULLIF(TRIM(o.material_name), ''))
    END AS material_name,
    SUM(COALESCE(o.adjust_order_qty, 0)) AS demand_qty,
    SUM(COALESCE(o.qtyallocated, 0)) AS allocated_qty,
    CASE
      WHEN SUM(COALESCE(o.adjust_order_qty, 0)) - SUM(COALESCE(o.qtyallocated, 0)) > 0
      THEN SUM(COALESCE(o.adjust_order_qty, 0)) - SUM(COALESCE(o.qtyallocated, 0))
      ELSE 0
    END AS remaining_qty,
    COUNT(*) AS source_row_count,
    MAX(
      CASE
        WHEN m.pickup_point IS NULL
        OR NULLIF(TRIM(o.cust_order_no), '') IS NULL
        OR NULLIF(TRIM(o.material_code), '') IS NULL
        THEN 1
        ELSE 0
      END
    ) AS input_invalid
  FROM agents_scm_execute_detail_d AS o
  LEFT JOIN point_locations AS m
    ON o.pickup_point = m.pickup_point
  WHERE
    o.bizflowstatus IN (
      '等待组波',
      '组波中',
      '组波完成',
      '组波失败',
      '提交成功',
      '提交中',
      '提交失败',
      '上传验证',
      '人工释放占用',
      '撤回待改单',
      '创建'
    )

      NOT m.pickup_point IS NULL OR NOT NULLIF(TRIM(o.belong_base), '') IS NULL
    )
  GROUP BY
    o.cust_order_no,
    o.material_code,
    CASE WHEN m.pickup_point IS NULL THEN '待映射' ELSE m.location_type END,
    CASE

      '人工释放占用',
      '撤回待改单',
      '创建'
    )
    AND (
      NOT m.pickup_point IS NULL OR NOT NULLIF(TRIM(o.belong_base), '') IS NULL
    )
  GROUP BY
    o.cust_order_no,
    o.material_code,
    CASE WHEN m.pickup_point IS NULL THEN '待映射' ELSE m.location_type END,
    CASE
      WHEN m.pickup_point IS NULL
      THEN CONCAT('unmapped:', COALESCE(o.pickup_point, 'NULL'))
      ELSE m.location_code
    END
), location_sku_demand AS (
  SELECT
    eligible_order_sku.location_type AS location_type,
    eligible_order_sku.location_code AS location_code,
    eligible_order_sku.material_code AS material_code,
    MAX(eligible_order_sku.location_name) AS location_name,
    MAX(eligible_order_sku.belong_base) AS belong_base,
    MAX(eligible_order_sku.warehouseid) AS warehouseid,
    CASE
      WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT eligible_order_sku.material_name) = 1
      THEN MAX(eligible_order_sku.material_name)
    END AS material_name,
    SUM(eligible_order_sku.demand_qty) AS demand_qty,
    SUM(eligible_order_sku.allocated_qty) AS allocated_qty,
    SUM(eligible_order_sku.remaining_qty) AS remaining_qty,
    SUM(eligible_order_sku.source_row_count) AS source_row_count,
    COUNT(*) AS order_sku_count,
    MAX(eligible_order_sku.input_invalid) AS input_invalid
  FROM eligible_order_sku AS eligible_order_sku
  GROUP BY
    eligible_order_sku.location_type,
    eligible_order_sku.location_code,
    eligible_order_sku.material_code
), complete_demand AS (
  SELECT
    location_sku_demand.location_type AS location_type,
    location_sku_demand.location_code AS location_code,
    location_sku_demand.material_code AS material_code,
    location_sku_demand.location_name AS location_name,
    location_sku_demand.belong_base AS belong_base,
    location_sku_demand.warehouseid AS warehouseid,
    location_sku_demand.material_name AS material_name,
    location_sku_demand.demand_qty AS demand_qty,
    location_sku_demand.allocated_qty AS allocated_qty,
    location_sku_demand.remaining_qty AS remaining_qty,
    location_sku_demand.source_row_count AS source_row_count,
    location_sku_demand.order_sku_count AS order_sku_count,
    location_sku_demand.input_invalid AS input_invalid
  FROM location_sku_demand AS location_sku_demand
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    l.location_type AS location_type,
    l.location_code AS location_code,
    CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR(255)) AS material_code,
    MAX(l.location_name) AS location_name,
    MAX(l.belong_base) AS belong_base,
    CASE WHEN l.location_type = '分仓' THEN MAX(l.warehouseid) END AS warehouseid,
    CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR(255)) AS material_name,
    0 AS demand_qty,
    0 AS allocated_qty,
    0 AS remaining_qty,
    0 AS source_row_count,
    0 AS order_sku_count,
    0 AS input_invalid
  FROM inventory_rows AS l
  LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT
      location_sku_demand.location_type AS location_type,
      location_sku_demand.location_code AS location_code
    FROM location_sku_demand AS location_sku_demand
    GROUP BY
      location_sku_demand.location_type,
      location_sku_demand.location_code
  ) AS d
    ON l.location_type = d.location_type AND l.location_code = d.location_code
  WHERE
    d.location_code IS NULL AND NOT NULLIF(TRIM(l.location_code), '') IS NULL
  GROUP BY
    l.location_type,
    l.location_code
), inventory_batch AS (
  SELECT
    inventory_rows.location_type AS location_type,
    inventory_rows.location_code AS location_code,
    inventory_rows.material_code AS material_code,
    inventory_rows.warehouseid AS warehouseid,
    inventory_rows.prod_date AS prod_date,
    inventory_rows.sap_warehouseid AS sap_warehouseid,
    inventory_rows.plant AS plant,
    inventory_rows.quality_batch AS quality_batch,
    inventory_rows.is_good_prod AS is_good_prod,
    inventory_rows.warehouse_classify AS warehouse_classify,
    SUM(COALESCE(inventory_rows.available_qty, 0)) AS available_qty,
    CASE
      WHEN COUNT(CASE WHEN COALESCE(inventory_rows.available_qty, 0) <> 0 THEN 1 END) > 1
      THEN 1
      ELSE 0
    END AS duplicate_batch
  FROM inventory_rows AS inventory_rows
  GROUP BY
    inventory_rows.location_type,
    inventory_rows.location_code,
    inventory_rows.material_code,
    inventory_rows.warehouseid,
    inventory_rows.prod_date,
    inventory_rows.sap_warehouseid,
    inventory_rows.plant,
    inventory_rows.quality_batch,
    inventory_rows.is_good_prod,
    inventory_rows.warehouse_classify
), material_attributes AS (
  SELECT
    agents_scm_material_in_out_summary_d.material_code AS material_code,
    CASE
      WHEN COUNT(
        DISTINCT NULLIF(TRIM(agents_scm_material_in_out_summary_d.product_categ_name), '')
      ) = 1
      THEN MAX(NULLIF(TRIM(agents_scm_material_in_out_summary_d.product_categ_name), ''))
    END AS product_categ_name,
    CASE
      WHEN COUNT(
        DISTINCT NULLIF(TRIM(agents_scm_material_in_out_summary_d.material_group_name), '')
      ) = 1
      THEN MAX(NULLIF(TRIM(agents_scm_material_in_out_summary_d.material_group_name), ''))
    END AS material_group_name
  FROM agents_scm_material_in_out_summary_d AS agents_scm_material_in_out_summary_d
  GROUP BY
    agents_scm_material_in_out_summary_d.material_code
), inventory_sku AS (
  SELECT
    inventory_batch.location_type AS location_type,
    inventory_batch.location_code AS location_code,
    inventory_batch.material_code AS material_code,
    SUM(inventory_batch.available_qty) AS available_qty,
    SUM(inventory_batch.duplicate_batch) AS duplicate_batch
  FROM inventory_batch AS inventory_batch
  GROUP BY
    inventory_batch.location_type,
    inventory_batch.location_code,
    inventory_batch.material_code
), shortage_source AS (SELECT
  CAST(CONCAT(
    SUBSTRING(s.month_date, 1, 4),
    '-',
    SUBSTRING(s.month_date, 5, 2),
    '-',
    SUBSTRING(s.month_date, 7, 2)
  ) AS DATE) AS stat_date,
  d.location_type AS location_type,
  d.location_code AS location_code,
  d.location_name AS location_name,
  d.belong_base AS belong_base,
  d.warehouseid AS warehouseid,
  d.material_code AS material_code,
  d.material_name AS material_name,
  a.product_categ_name AS product_categ_name,
  a.material_group_name AS material_group_name,
  d.demand_qty AS demand_qty,
  d.allocated_qty AS allocated_qty,
  d.remaining_qty AS remaining_qty,
  CASE
    WHEN d.input_invalid = 0
    AND COALESCE(i.duplicate_batch, 0) = 0
    AND NOT s.month_date IS NULL
    THEN COALESCE(i.available_qty, 0)
  END AS available_qty,
  CASE
    WHEN d.input_invalid = 0
    AND COALESCE(i.duplicate_batch, 0) = 0
    AND NOT s.month_date IS NULL
    THEN CASE
      WHEN d.remaining_qty - COALESCE(i.available_qty, 0) > 0
      THEN d.remaining_qty - COALESCE(i.available_qty, 0)
      ELSE 0
    END
  END AS shortage_qty,
  d.source_row_count AS source_row_count,
  d.order_sku_count AS order_sku_count,
  CASE
    WHEN d.input_invalid <> 0
    OR COALESCE(i.duplicate_batch, 0) <> 0
    OR s.month_date IS NULL
    THEN 1
    ELSE 0
  END AS invalid_sku,
  CASE
    WHEN d.order_sku_count > 0
    AND i.material_code IS NULL
    AND d.input_invalid = 0
    AND NOT s.month_date IS NULL
    THEN 1
    ELSE 0
  END AS absent_inventory_sku
FROM complete_demand AS d
CROSS JOIN latest_inventory AS s
LEFT JOIN inventory_sku AS i
  ON d.location_type = i.location_type
  AND d.location_code = i.location_code
  AND d.material_code = i.material_code
LEFT JOIN material_attributes AS a
  ON d.material_code = a.material_code), order_presence AS (
 SELECT COUNT(*) AS source_order_count FROM (SELECT 1 AS present FROM agents_scm_execute_detail_d AS probe_order LIMIT 1) AS order_probe
 ), filtered AS (
 SELECT r.stat_date AS snapshot_date, r.location_type AS location_type, r.location_code AS location_code, r.location_name AS location_name, r.belong_base AS base, r.warehouseid AS warehouse_code, r.material_code AS sku, r.material_name AS material_name, r.product_categ_name AS category, r.material_group_name AS material_group, r.demand_qty AS demand, r.allocated_qty AS allocated, r.remaining_qty AS remaining, r.available_qty AS available, r.shortage_qty AS shortage,
 CASE WHEN p.source_order_count=0 THEN 1 ELSE r.invalid_sku END AS invalid
 FROM shortage_source AS r CROSS JOIN order_presence AS p
 WHERE (:gea_p1 IS NULL OR r.belong_base=:gea_p1)
 AND (:gea_p2 IS NULL OR r.warehouseid=:gea_p2)
 AND (:gea_p3 IS NULL OR r.material_code=:gea_p3)
 AND (:gea_p6 IS NULL OR r.product_categ_name=:gea_p6)
 AND r.material_code IN (:gea_p7)
)
SELECT f.snapshot_date AS snapshot_date, f.location_type AS location_type, f.base AS base, f.sku AS sku, SUM(f.demand) AS demand, SUM(f.allocated) AS allocated, SUM(f.remaining) AS remaining, CASE WHEN SUM(f.invalid)>0 THEN NULL ELSE SUM(f.available) END AS available, CASE WHEN SUM(f.invalid)>0 THEN NULL ELSE SUM(f.shortage) END AS shortage, SUM(f.invalid) AS invalid FROM filtered AS f GROUP BY f.snapshot_date, f.location_type, f.base, f.sku ORDER BY f.snapshot_date, f.location_type, f.base, f.sku

current-shortage.skus.notes: 仅统一GEA受控SQL；复用已验证三层逻辑和11种状态含创建，短拨调账同步层已排除；无日期截断；当前状态不可重建历史；可用库存只扣一次；跨SKU不抵消。

batch-age.groups.title: 批次货龄结构
batch-age.groups.notes: 批次生产日期计算货龄；正库存有效批次数量加权，未知货龄单列，不用最大值冒充平均值。FIFO在仓库/SKU内扣近30日正向发货日均×窗口，按SKU截零后汇总。基地未来7/14日为新增跨60天风险，排除当前60+。全链未来7/14日为基地>60/分仓>=90的期末风险量。不以其他SKU库存或销量抵消。

request.sql:
WITH inventory_batch_dates AS (
SELECT b.warehouse_classify AS warehouse_classify, b.warehouseid AS warehouseid, b.material_code AS material_code,
 b.month_date AS month_date,
 b.warehouse_name AS warehouse_name, b.belong_base AS belong_base, b.material_name AS material_name,
 b.live_qty AS live_qty, b.available_qty AS available_qty,
 b.pack_unit_qty AS pack_unit_qty, b.freeze_qty AS freeze_qty,
 CAST(SUBSTRING(b.month_date, 1, 4) AS INTEGER) AS snapshot_year,
 CAST(SUBSTRING(b.month_date, 5, 2) AS INTEGER) AS snapshot_month,
 CAST(SUBSTRING(b.month_date, 7, 2) AS INTEGER) AS snapshot_day,
 CASE WHEN LENGTH(b.prod_date) >= 10 AND SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 5, 1) = '-' AND SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 8, 1) = '-' AND SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 1, 1) BETWEEN '0' AND '9' AND SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 2, 1) BETWEEN '0' AND '9' AND SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 3, 1) BETWEEN '0' AND '9' AND SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 4, 1) BETWEEN '0' AND '9' AND SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 6, 1) BETWEEN '0' AND '9' AND SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 7, 1) BETWEEN '0' AND '9' AND SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 9, 1) BETWEEN '0' AND '9' AND SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 10, 1) BETWEEN '0' AND '9' THEN CAST(SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 1, 4) AS INTEGER) ELSE NULL END AS production_year,
 CASE WHEN LENGTH(b.prod_date) >= 10 AND SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 5, 1) = '-' AND SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 8, 1) = '-' AND SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 1, 1) BETWEEN '0' AND '9' AND SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 2, 1) BETWEEN '0' AND '9' AND SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 3, 1) BETWEEN '0' AND '9' AND SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 4, 1) BETWEEN '0' AND '9' AND SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 6, 1) BETWEEN '0' AND '9' AND SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 7, 1) BETWEEN '0' AND '9' AND SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 9, 1) BETWEEN '0' AND '9' AND SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 10, 1) BETWEEN '0' AND '9' THEN CAST(SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 6, 2) AS INTEGER) ELSE NULL END AS production_month,
 CASE WHEN LENGTH(b.prod_date) >= 10 AND SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 5, 1) = '-' AND SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 8, 1) = '-' AND SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 1, 1) BETWEEN '0' AND '9' AND SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 2, 1) BETWEEN '0' AND '9' AND SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 3, 1) BETWEEN '0' AND '9' AND SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 4, 1) BETWEEN '0' AND '9' AND SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 6, 1) BETWEEN '0' AND '9' AND SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 7, 1) BETWEEN '0' AND '9' AND SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 9, 1) BETWEEN '0' AND '9' AND SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 10, 1) BETWEEN '0' AND '9' THEN CAST(SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 9, 2) AS INTEGER) ELSE NULL END AS production_day
FROM agents_scm_inventory_sku_data_d AS b
WHERE b.warehouse_classify IN ('01', '02', '20') AND b.month_date = REPLACE(CAST(:gea_p1 AS VARCHAR(10)), '-', '') AND (:gea_p2 = FALSE OR b.belong_base IN (:gea_p3)) AND (:gea_p4 IS NULL OR b.warehouseid = :gea_p4) AND (:gea_p5 IS NULL OR b.material_code = :gea_p5)
), inventory_batch_ages AS (
SELECT d.warehouse_classify AS warehouse_classify, d.warehouseid AS warehouseid, d.material_code AS material_code,
 d.month_date AS month_date,
 d.warehouse_name AS warehouse_name, d.belong_base AS belong_base, d.material_name AS material_name,
 d.live_qty AS live_qty, d.available_qty AS available_qty,
 d.pack_unit_qty AS pack_unit_qty, d.freeze_qty AS freeze_qty,
 CASE WHEN d.live_qty > 0 AND d.production_year > 0
 AND d.production_month BETWEEN 1 AND 12 AND d.production_day >= 1 AND d.production_day <= CASE WHEN d.production_month=2 THEN CASE WHEN (d.production_year-4*FLOOR(d.production_year/4.0)=0 AND (d.production_year-100*FLOOR(d.production_year/100.0)<>0 OR d.production_year-400*FLOOR(d.production_year/400.0)=0)) THEN 29 ELSE 28 END WHEN d.production_month IN (4,6,9,11) THEN 30 ELSE 31 END
 AND (365 * (d.snapshot_year - CASE WHEN d.snapshot_month <= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) + FLOOR((d.snapshot_year - CASE WHEN d.snapshot_month <= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / 4.0) - FLOOR((d.snapshot_year - CASE WHEN d.snapshot_month <= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / 100.0) + FLOOR((d.snapshot_year - CASE WHEN d.snapshot_month <= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / 400.0) + FLOOR((153 * (d.snapshot_month + CASE WHEN d.snapshot_month > 2 THEN -3 ELSE 9 END) + 2) / 5.0) + d.snapshot_day) >= (365 * (d.production_year - CASE WHEN d.production_month <= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) + FLOOR((d.production_year - CASE WHEN d.production_month <= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / 4.0) - FLOOR((d.production_year - CASE WHEN d.production_month <= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / 100.0) + FLOOR((d.production_year - CASE WHEN d.production_month <= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / 400.0) + FLOOR((153 * (d.production_month + CASE WHEN d.production_month > 2 THEN -3 ELSE 9 END) + 2) / 5.0) + d.production_day) THEN (365 * (d.snapshot_year - CASE WHEN d.snapshot_month <= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) + FLOOR((d.snapshot_year - CASE WHEN d.snapshot_month <= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / 4.0) - FLOOR((d.snapshot_year - CASE WHEN d.snapshot_month <= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / 100.0) + FLOOR((d.snapshot_year - CASE WHEN d.snapshot_month <= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / 400.0) + FLOOR((153 * (d.snapshot_month + CASE WHEN d.snapshot_month > 2 THEN -3 ELSE 9 END) + 2) / 5.0) + d.snapshot_day) - (365 * (d.production_year - CASE WHEN d.production_month <= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) + FLOOR((d.production_year - CASE WHEN d.production_month <= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / 4.0) - FLOOR((d.production_year - CASE WHEN d.production_month <= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / 100.0) + FLOOR((d.production_year - CASE WHEN d.production_month <= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / 400.0) + FLOOR((153 * (d.production_month + CASE WHEN d.production_month > 2 THEN -3 ELSE 9 END) + 2) / 5.0) + d.production_day) ELSE NULL END AS age_days
FROM inventory_batch_dates AS d
), batch_skus AS (
 SELECT a.month_date AS month_date, a.warehouseid AS warehouseid, a.material_code AS material_code,
 CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT NULLIF(TRIM(a.belong_base),''))=1 THEN MAX(NULLIF(TRIM(a.belong_base),'')) ELSE NULL END AS belong_base,
 CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT NULLIF(TRIM(a.warehouse_name),''))=1 THEN MAX(NULLIF(TRIM(a.warehouse_name),'')) ELSE NULL END AS warehouse_name,
 CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT NULLIF(TRIM(a.material_name),''))=1 THEN MAX(NULLIF(TRIM(a.material_name),'')) ELSE NULL END AS material_name,
 SUM(COALESCE(a.live_qty,0)) AS total_qty, SUM(COALESCE(a.available_qty,0)) AS available_qty, SUM(COALESCE(a.pack_unit_qty,0)) AS pack_unit_qty, SUM(COALESCE(a.freeze_qty,0)) AS freeze_qty,
 SUM(CASE WHEN a.age_days IS NOT NULL THEN a.live_qty ELSE 0 END) AS age_weight_qty,
 SUM(CASE WHEN a.age_days IS NOT NULL THEN a.live_qty*a.age_days ELSE 0 END) AS weighted_age,
 SUM(CASE WHEN a.live_qty>0 AND a.age_days IS NULL THEN a.live_qty ELSE 0 END) AS unknown_age_qty,
 MAX(a.age_days) AS max_age,
 SUM(CASE WHEN a.age_days BETWEEN 0 AND 30 THEN a.live_qty ELSE 0 END) AS age0_30,
 SUM(CASE WHEN a.age_days BETWEEN 31 AND 40 THEN a.live_qty ELSE 0 END) AS age31_40,
 SUM(CASE WHEN a.age_days BETWEEN 41 AND 60 THEN a.live_qty ELSE 0 END) AS age41_60,
 SUM(CASE WHEN a.age_days > 60 THEN a.live_qty ELSE 0 END) AS age60_plus,
 SUM(CASE WHEN a.age_days > 30 AND a.age_days <= 60 THEN a.live_qty ELSE 0 END) AS age31_60,
 SUM(CASE WHEN a.age_days > 60 AND a.age_days <= 90 THEN a.live_qty ELSE 0 END) AS age61_90,
 SUM(CASE WHEN a.age_days > 90 THEN a.live_qty ELSE 0 END) AS age90_plus,
 SUM(CASE WHEN a.age_days >= 60 AND a.age_days < 90 THEN a.live_qty ELSE 0 END) AS age60_89,
 SUM(CASE WHEN a.age_days >= 90 AND a.age_days < 120 THEN a.live_qty ELSE 0 END) AS age90_119,
 SUM(CASE WHEN a.age_days >= 60 THEN a.live_qty ELSE 0 END) AS overaged_qty,
 SUM(CASE WHEN a.age_days >= 90 THEN a.live_qty ELSE 0 END) AS stagnant_qty,
 SUM(CASE WHEN a.age_days >= 53 THEN a.live_qty ELSE 0 END) AS future7_candidates,
 SUM(CASE WHEN a.age_days >= 46 THEN a.live_qty ELSE 0 END) AS future14_candidates,
 SUM(CASE WHEN (a.warehouse_classify IN ('01','02') AND a.age_days > 60) OR (a.warehouse_classify = '20' AND a.age_days >= 90) THEN a.live_qty ELSE 0 END) AS risk_current,
 SUM(CASE WHEN (a.warehouse_classify IN ('01','02') AND a.age_days > 53) OR (a.warehouse_classify = '20' AND a.age_days >= 83) THEN a.live_qty ELSE 0 END) AS risk7_candidates,
 SUM(CASE WHEN (a.warehouse_classify IN ('01','02') AND a.age_days > 46) OR (a.warehouse_classify = '20' AND a.age_days >= 76) THEN a.live_qty ELSE 0 END) AS risk14_candidates
 FROM inventory_batch_ages AS a GROUP BY a.month_date,a.warehouseid,a.material_code
), batch_names AS (
 SELECT n.warehouseid AS warehouseid,n.material_code AS material_code,
 CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT NULLIF(TRIM(n.product_categ_name),''))=1 THEN MAX(NULLIF(TRIM(n.product_categ_name),'')) ELSE NULL END AS category,
 CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT NULLIF(TRIM(n.material_group_name),''))=1 THEN MAX(NULLIF(TRIM(n.material_group_name),'')) ELSE NULL END AS material_group
 FROM agents_scm_material_in_out_summary_d AS n
 INNER JOIN batch_skus AS b ON b.warehouseid=n.warehouseid AND b.material_code=n.material_code
 GROUP BY n.warehouseid,n.material_code
), batch_sales AS (
 SELECT s.warehouse AS warehouseid,s.material_code AS material_code,
 SUM(CASE WHEN s.act_dl_qty>0 THEN s.act_dl_qty ELSE 0 END)/30.0 AS daily_movement
 FROM agents_scm_cust_deliv_daily_di AS s
 WHERE s.act_ship_date>=:gea_p6 AND s.act_ship_date<:gea_p7
 AND (:gea_p4 IS NULL OR s.warehouse=:gea_p4) AND (:gea_p5 IS NULL OR s.material_code=:gea_p5)
 GROUP BY s.warehouse,s.material_code
), batch_facts AS (
 SELECT b.warehouseid AS warehouseid,b.belong_base AS belong_base,b.warehouse_name AS warehouse_name,
 b.material_code AS material_code,b.material_name AS material_name,
 COALESCE(n.category,'未分类') AS product_categ_name,n.material_group AS material_group_name,
 b.available_qty AS available_qty,b.pack_unit_qty AS pack_unit_qty,b.freeze_qty AS freeze_qty,b.total_qty AS total_qty,b.age_weight_qty AS age_weight_qty,b.weighted_age AS weighted_age,
 b.unknown_age_qty AS unknown_age_qty,b.max_age AS max_age,
 b.age0_30 AS age0_30, b.age31_40 AS age31_40, b.age41_60 AS age41_60, b.age60_plus AS age60_plus, b.age31_60 AS age31_60, b.age61_90 AS age61_90, b.age90_plus AS age90_plus, b.age60_89 AS age60_89, b.age90_119 AS age90_119, b.overaged_qty AS overaged_qty, b.stagnant_qty AS stagnant_qty, b.risk_current AS risk_current,
 COALESCE(s.daily_movement,0) AS daily_movement,
 (CASE WHEN b.future7_candidates-7*COALESCE(s.daily_movement,0) > 0 THEN b.future7_candidates-7*COALESCE(s.daily_movement,0) ELSE 0 END)-(CASE WHEN b.age60_plus-7*COALESCE(s.daily_movement,0) > 0 THEN b.age60_plus-7*COALESCE(s.daily_movement,0) ELSE 0 END) AS future7,
 (CASE WHEN b.future14_candidates-14*COALESCE(s.daily_movement,0) > 0 THEN b.future14_candidates-14*COALESCE(s.daily_movement,0) ELSE 0 END)-(CASE WHEN b.age60_plus-14*COALESCE(s.daily_movement,0) > 0 THEN b.age60_plus-14*COALESCE(s.daily_movement,0) ELSE 0 END) AS future14,
 (CASE WHEN b.risk7_candidates-7*COALESCE(s.daily_movement,0) > 0 THEN b.risk7_candidates-7*COALESCE(s.daily_movement,0) ELSE 0 END) AS projected_risk7,
 (CASE WHEN b.risk14_candidates-14*COALESCE(s.daily_movement,0) > 0 THEN b.risk14_candidates-14*COALESCE(s.daily_movement,0) ELSE 0 END) AS projected_risk14
 FROM batch_skus AS b LEFT JOIN batch_names AS n ON b.warehouseid=n.warehouseid AND b.material_code=n.material_code
 LEFT JOIN batch_sales AS s ON b.warehouseid=s.warehouseid AND b.material_code=s.material_code
 WHERE (:gea_p8 IS NULL OR COALESCE(n.category,'未分类')=:gea_p8)
 AND (:gea_p12 IS NULL OR b.material_code LIKE :gea_p12 OR b.material_name LIKE :gea_p12)
), batch_groups AS (
 SELECT CASE WHEN :gea_p9='base' THEN b.belong_base WHEN :gea_p9='category' THEN b.product_categ_name ELSE b.material_code END AS level,
 CASE WHEN :gea_p9='detail' THEN b.warehouseid ELSE NULL END AS warehouseid,
 CASE WHEN :gea_p9 IN ('sku','detail') THEN b.material_code ELSE NULL END AS material_code,
 CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT b.belong_base)=1 THEN MAX(b.belong_base) ELSE NULL END AS belong_base,
 CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT b.warehouse_name)=1 THEN MAX(b.warehouse_name) ELSE NULL END AS warehouse_name,
 CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT b.material_name)=1 THEN MAX(b.material_name) ELSE NULL END AS material_name,
 CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT b.product_categ_name)=1 THEN MAX(b.product_categ_name) ELSE NULL END AS product_categ_name,
 CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT b.material_group_name)=1 THEN MAX(b.material_group_name) ELSE NULL END AS material_group_name,
 COUNT(*) AS row_count,COUNT(CASE WHEN b.age_weight_qty>0 THEN 1 ELSE NULL END) AS age_valid_count, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN b.overaged_qty>0 THEN b.material_code ELSE NULL END) AS is_overaged_sku_count, CAST(NULL AS INTEGER) AS is_low_stock_sku_count,CAST(NULL AS INTEGER) AS is_high_stock_sku_count,CAST(NULL AS INTEGER) AS conflicting_stock_flag_skus,CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR(255)) AS source_updated_at,COUNT(DISTINCT b.material_code) AS sku_count,
 SUM(b.available_qty) AS available_qty,SUM(b.pack_unit_qty) AS pack_unit_qty,SUM(b.freeze_qty) AS freeze_qty,CAST(:gea_p1 AS DATE) AS stat_date,MAX(b.max_age) AS age_days,SUM(b.total_qty) AS total_qty, SUM(b.age_weight_qty) AS age_weight_qty,SUM(b.weighted_age) AS weighted_age,
 SUM(b.unknown_age_qty) AS unknown_age_qty,MAX(b.max_age) AS max_age,
 CASE WHEN SUM(b.age_weight_qty)>0 THEN SUM(b.weighted_age)*1.0/SUM(b.age_weight_qty) ELSE NULL END AS average_age,
 SUM(b.age0_30) AS age0_30, SUM(b.age31_40) AS age31_40, SUM(b.age41_60) AS age41_60, SUM(b.age60_plus) AS age60_plus, SUM(b.age31_60) AS age31_60, SUM(b.age61_90) AS age61_90, SUM(b.age90_plus) AS age90_plus, SUM(b.age60_89) AS age60_89, SUM(b.age90_119) AS age90_119, SUM(b.overaged_qty) AS overaged_qty, SUM(b.stagnant_qty) AS stagnant_qty, SUM(b.risk_current) AS risk_current,
 SUM(b.daily_movement) AS daily_movement,SUM(b.future7) AS future7,SUM(b.future14) AS future14,
 SUM(b.projected_risk7) AS projected_risk7,SUM(b.projected_risk14) AS projected_risk14,
 CASE WHEN SUM(b.daily_movement)>0 THEN SUM(b.total_qty)*1.0/SUM(b.daily_movement) ELSE NULL END AS historical_turnover,
 CASE WHEN SUM(b.age_weight_qty)=0 THEN NULL WHEN SUM(b.stagnant_qty)>0 THEN '滞库' WHEN SUM(b.overaged_qty)>0 THEN '预警' ELSE '正常' END AS warning
 FROM batch_facts AS b
 GROUP BY CASE WHEN :gea_p9='base' THEN b.belong_base WHEN :gea_p9='category' THEN b.product_categ_name ELSE b.material_code END,
 CASE WHEN :gea_p9='detail' THEN b.warehouseid ELSE NULL END,
 CASE WHEN :gea_p9 IN ('sku','detail') THEN b.material_code ELSE NULL END

g.warehouse_name AS warehouse_name, g.material_name AS material_name, g.product_categ_name AS product_categ_name, g.material_group_name AS material_group_name, g.sku_count AS sku_count, g.total_qty AS age90_119, g.overaged_qty AS overaged_qty, g.stagnant_qty AS stagnant_qty, g.risk_current AS risk_current, g.daily_movement AS daily_movement, g.future7 AS future7, g.future14 AS future14,
