batch-age.count.title: 批次货龄结构
batch-age.count.notes: 批次生产日期计算货龄；正库存有效批次数量加权，未知货龄单列，不用最大值冒充平均值。FIFO在仓库/SKU内扣近30日正向发货日均×窗口，按SKU截零后汇总。基地未来7/14日为新增跨60天风险，排除当前60+。全链未来7/14日为基地>60/分仓>=90的期末风险量。不以其他SKU库存或销量抵消。

request.sql:
WITH inventory_batch_dates AS (
SELECT b.warehouse_classify AS warehouse_classify, b.warehouseid AS warehouseid, b.material_code AS material_code,
 b.month_date AS month_date,
 b.warehouse_name AS warehouse_name, b.belong_base AS belong_base, b.material_name AS material_name,
 b.live_qty AS live_qty, b.available_qty AS available_qty,
 b.pack_unit_qty AS pack_unit_qty, b.freeze_qty AS freeze_qty,
 CAST(SUBSTRING(b.month_date, 1, 4) AS INTEGER) AS snapshot_year,
 CAST(SUBSTRING(b.month_date, 5, 2) AS INTEGER) AS snapshot_month,
 CAST(SUBSTRING(b.month_date, 7, 2) AS INTEGER) AS snapshot_day,
 CASE WHEN LENGTH(b.prod_date) >= 10 AND SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 5, 1) = '-' AND SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 8, 1) = '-' AND SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 1, 1) BETWEEN '0' AND '9' AND SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 2, 1) BETWEEN '0' AND '9' AND SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 3, 1) BETWEEN '0' AND '9' AND SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 4, 1) BETWEEN '0' AND '9' AND SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 6, 1) BETWEEN '0' AND '9' AND SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 7, 1) BETWEEN '0' AND '9' AND SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 9, 1) BETWEEN '0' AND '9' AND SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 10, 1) BETWEEN '0' AND '9' THEN CAST(SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 1, 4) AS INTEGER) ELSE NULL END AS production_year,
 CASE WHEN LENGTH(b.prod_date) >= 10 AND SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 5, 1) = '-' AND SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 8, 1) = '-' AND SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 1, 1) BETWEEN '0' AND '9' AND SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 2, 1) BETWEEN '0' AND '9' AND SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 3, 1) BETWEEN '0' AND '9' AND SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 4, 1) BETWEEN '0' AND '9' AND SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 6, 1) BETWEEN '0' AND '9' AND SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 7, 1) BETWEEN '0' AND '9' AND SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 9, 1) BETWEEN '0' AND '9' AND SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 10, 1) BETWEEN '0' AND '9' THEN CAST(SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 6, 2) AS INTEGER) ELSE NULL END AS production_month,
 CASE WHEN LENGTH(b.prod_date) >= 10 AND SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 5, 1) = '-' AND SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 8, 1) = '-' AND SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 1, 1) BETWEEN '0' AND '9' AND SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 2, 1) BETWEEN '0' AND '9' AND SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 3, 1) BETWEEN '0' AND '9' AND SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 4, 1) BETWEEN '0' AND '9' AND SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 6, 1) BETWEEN '0' AND '9' AND SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 7, 1) BETWEEN '0' AND '9' AND SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 9, 1) BETWEEN '0' AND '9' AND SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 10, 1) BETWEEN '0' AND '9' THEN CAST(SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 9, 2) AS INTEGER) ELSE NULL END AS production_day
FROM agents_scm_inventory_sku_data_d AS b
WHERE b.warehouse_classify IN ('01', '02', '20') AND b.month_date = REPLACE(CAST(:gea_p1 AS VARCHAR(10)), '-', '') AND (:gea_p2 = FALSE OR b.belong_base IN (:gea_p3)) AND (:gea_p4 IS NULL OR b.warehouseid = :gea_p4) AND (:gea_p5 IS NULL OR b.material_code = :gea_p5)
), inventory_batch_ages AS (
SELECT d.warehouse_classify AS warehouse_classify, d.warehouseid AS warehouseid, d.material_code AS material_code,
 d.month_date AS month_date,
 d.warehouse_name AS warehouse_name, d.belong_base AS belong_base, d.material_name AS material_name,
 d.live_qty AS live_qty, d.available_qty AS available_qty,
 d.pack_unit_qty AS pack_unit_qty, d.freeze_qty AS freeze_qty,
 CASE WHEN d.live_qty > 0 AND d.production_year > 0
 AND d.production_month BETWEEN 1 AND 12 AND d.production_day >= 1 AND d.production_day <= CASE WHEN d.production_month=2 THEN CASE WHEN (d.production_year-4*FLOOR(d.production_year/4.0)=0 AND (d.production_year-100*FLOOR(d.production_year/100.0)<>0 OR d.production_year-400*FLOOR(d.production_year/400.0)=0)) THEN 29 ELSE 28 END WHEN d.production_month IN (4,6,9,11) THEN 30 ELSE 31 END
 AND (365 * (d.snapshot_year - CASE WHEN d.snapshot_month <= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) + FLOOR((d.snapshot_year - CASE WHEN d.snapshot_month <= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / 4.0) - FLOOR((d.snapshot_year - CASE WHEN d.snapshot_month <= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / 100.0) + FLOOR((d.snapshot_year - CASE WHEN d.snapshot_month <= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / 400.0) + FLOOR((153 * (d.snapshot_month + CASE WHEN d.snapshot_month > 2 THEN -3 ELSE 9 END) + 2) / 5.0) + d.snapshot_day) >= (365 * (d.production_year - CASE WHEN d.production_month <= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) + FLOOR((d.production_year - CASE WHEN d.production_month <= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / 4.0) - FLOOR((d.production_year - CASE WHEN d.production_month <= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / 100.0) + FLOOR((d.production_year - CASE WHEN d.production_month <= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / 400.0) + FLOOR((153 * (d.production_month + CASE WHEN d.production_month > 2 THEN -3 ELSE 9 END) + 2) / 5.0) + d.production_day) THEN (365 * (d.snapshot_year - CASE WHEN d.snapshot_month <= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) + FLOOR((d.snapshot_year - CASE WHEN d.snapshot_month <= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / 4.0) - FLOOR((d.snapshot_year - CASE WHEN d.snapshot_month <= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / 100.0) + FLOOR((d.snapshot_year - CASE WHEN d.snapshot_month <= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / 400.0) + FLOOR((153 * (d.snapshot_month + CASE WHEN d.snapshot_month > 2 THEN -3 ELSE 9 END) + 2) / 5.0) + d.snapshot_day) - (365 * (d.production_year - CASE WHEN d.production_month <= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) + FLOOR((d.production_year - CASE WHEN d.production_month <= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / 4.0) - FLOOR((d.production_year - CASE WHEN d.production_month <= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / 100.0) + FLOOR((d.production_year - CASE WHEN d.production_month <= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / 400.0) + FLOOR((153 * (d.production_month + CASE WHEN d.production_month > 2 THEN -3 ELSE 9 END) + 2) / 5.0) + d.production_day) ELSE NULL END AS age_days
FROM inventory_batch_dates AS d
), batch_skus AS (
 SELECT a.month_date AS month_date, a.warehouseid AS warehouseid, a.material_code AS material_code,
 CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT NULLIF(TRIM(a.belong_base),''))=1 THEN MAX(NULLIF(TRIM(a.belong_base),'')) ELSE NULL END AS belong_base,
 CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT NULLIF(TRIM(a.warehouse_name),''))=1 THEN MAX(NULLIF(TRIM(a.warehouse_name),'')) ELSE NULL END AS warehouse_name,
 CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT NULLIF(TRIM(a.material_name),''))=1 THEN MAX(NULLIF(TRIM(a.material_name),'')) ELSE NULL END AS material_name,
 SUM(COALESCE(a.live_qty,0)) AS total_qty, SUM(COALESCE(a.available_qty,0)) AS available_qty, SUM(COALESCE(a.pack_unit_qty,0)) AS pack_unit_qty, SUM(COALESCE(a.freeze_qty,0)) AS freeze_qty,
 SUM(CASE WHEN a.age_days IS NOT NULL THEN a.live_qty ELSE 0 END) AS age_weight_qty,
 SUM(CASE WHEN a.age_days IS NOT NULL THEN a.live_qty*a.age_days ELSE 0 END) AS weighted_age,
 SUM(CASE WHEN a.live_qty>0 AND a.age_days IS NULL THEN a.live_qty ELSE 0 END) AS unknown_age_qty,
 MAX(a.age_days) AS max_age,
 SUM(CASE WHEN a.age_days BETWEEN 0 AND 30 THEN a.live_qty ELSE 0 END) AS age0_30,
 SUM(CASE WHEN a.age_days BETWEEN 31 AND 40 THEN a.live_qty ELSE 0 END) AS age31_40,
 SUM(CASE WHEN a.age_days BETWEEN 41 AND 60 THEN a.live_qty ELSE 0 END) AS age41_60,
 SUM(CASE WHEN a.age_days > 60 THEN a.live_qty ELSE 0 END) AS age60_plus,
 SUM(CASE WHEN a.age_days > 30 AND a.age_days <= 60 THEN a.live_qty ELSE 0 END) AS age31_60,
 SUM(CASE WHEN a.age_days > 60 AND a.age_days <= 90 THEN a.live_qty ELSE 0 END) AS age61_90,
 SUM(CASE WHEN a.age_days > 90 THEN a.live_qty ELSE 0 END) AS age90_plus,
 SUM(CASE WHEN a.age_days >= 60 AND a.age_days < 90 THEN a.live_qty ELSE 0 END) AS age60_89,
 SUM(CASE WHEN a.age_days >= 90 AND a.age_days < 120 THEN a.live_qty ELSE 0 END) AS age90_119,
 SUM(CASE WHEN a.age_days >= 60 THEN a.live_qty ELSE 0 END) AS overaged_qty,
 SUM(CASE WHEN a.age_days >= 90 THEN a.live_qty ELSE 0 END) AS stagnant_qty,
 SUM(CASE WHEN a.age_days >= 53 THEN a.live_qty ELSE 0 END) AS future7_candidates,
 SUM(CASE WHEN a.age_days >= 46 THEN a.live_qty ELSE 0 END) AS future14_candidates,
 SUM(CASE WHEN (a.warehouse_classify IN ('01','02') AND a.age_days > 60) OR (a.warehouse_classify = '20' AND a.age_days >= 90) THEN a.live_qty ELSE 0 END) AS risk_current,
 SUM(CASE WHEN (a.warehouse_classify IN ('01','02') AND a.age_days > 53) OR (a.warehouse_classify = '20' AND a.age_days >= 83) THEN a.live_qty ELSE 0 END) AS risk7_candidates,
 SUM(CASE WHEN (a.warehouse_classify IN ('01','02') AND a.age_days > 46) OR (a.warehouse_classify = '20' AND a.age_days >= 76) THEN a.live_qty ELSE 0 END) AS risk14_candidates
 FROM inventory_batch_ages AS a GROUP BY a.month_date,a.warehouseid,a.material_code
), batch_names AS (
 SELECT n.warehouseid AS warehouseid,n.material_code AS material_code,
 CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT NULLIF(TRIM(n.product_categ_name),''))=1 THEN MAX(NULLIF(TRIM(n.product_categ_name),'')) ELSE NULL END AS category,
 CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT NULLIF(TRIM(n.material_group_name),''))=1 THEN MAX(NULLIF(TRIM(n.material_group_name),'')) ELSE NULL END AS material_group
 FROM agents_scm_material_in_out_summary_d AS n
 INNER JOIN batch_skus AS b ON b.warehouseid=n.warehouseid AND b.material_code=n.material_code
 GROUP BY n.warehouseid,n.material_code
), batch_sales AS (
 SELECT s.warehouse AS warehouseid,s.material_code AS material_code,
 SUM(CASE WHEN s.act_dl_qty>0 THEN s.act_dl_qty ELSE 0 END)/30.0 AS daily_movement
 FROM agents_scm_cust_deliv_daily_di AS s
 WHERE s.act_ship_date>=:gea_p6 AND s.act_ship_date<:gea_p7
 AND (:gea_p4 IS NULL OR s.warehouse=:gea_p4) AND (:gea_p5 IS NULL OR s.material_code=:gea_p5)
 GROUP BY s.warehouse,s.material_code
), batch_facts AS (
 SELECT b.warehouseid AS warehouseid,b.belong_base AS belong_base,b.warehouse_name AS warehouse_name,
 b.material_code AS material_code,b.material_name AS material_name,
 COALESCE(n.category,'未分类') AS product_categ_name,n.material_group AS material_group_name,
 b.available_qty AS available_qty,b.pack_unit_qty AS pack_unit_qty,b.freeze_qty AS freeze_qty,b.total_qty AS total_qty,b.age_weight_qty AS age_weight_qty,b.weighted_age AS weighted_age,
 b.unknown_age_qty AS unknown_age_qty,b.max_age AS max_age,
 b.age0_30 AS age0_30, b.age31_40 AS age31_40, b.age41_60 AS age41_60, b.age60_plus AS age60_plus, b.age31_60 AS age31_60, b.age61_90 AS age61_90, b.age90_plus AS age90_plus, b.age60_89 AS age60_89, b.age90_119 AS age90_119, b.overaged_qty AS overaged_qty, b.stagnant_qty AS stagnant_qty, b.risk_current AS risk_current,
 COALESCE(s.daily_movement,0) AS daily_movement,
 (CASE WHEN b.future7_candidates-7*COALESCE(s.daily_movement,0) > 0 THEN b.future7_candidates-7*COALESCE(s.daily_movement,0) ELSE 0 END)-(CASE WHEN b.age60_plus-7*COALESCE(s.daily_movement,0) > 0 THEN b.age60_plus-7*COALESCE(s.daily_movement,0) ELSE 0 END) AS future7,
 (CASE WHEN b.future14_candidates-14*COALESCE(s.daily_movement,0) > 0 THEN b.future14_candidates-14*COALESCE(s.daily_movement,0) ELSE 0 END)-(CASE WHEN b.age60_plus-14*COALESCE(s.daily_movement,0) > 0 THEN b.age60_plus-14*COALESCE(s.daily_movement,0) ELSE 0 END) AS future14,
 (CASE WHEN b.risk7_candidates-7*COALESCE(s.daily_movement,0) > 0 THEN b.risk7_candidates-7*COALESCE(s.daily_movement,0) ELSE 0 END) AS projected_risk7,
 (CASE WHEN b.risk14_candidates-14*COALESCE(s.daily_movement,0) > 0 THEN b.risk14_candidates-14*COALESCE(s.daily_movement,0) ELSE 0 END) AS projected_risk14
 FROM batch_skus AS b LEFT JOIN batch_names AS n ON b.warehouseid=n.warehouseid AND b.material_code=n.material_code
 LEFT JOIN batch_sales AS s ON b.warehouseid=s.warehouseid AND b.material_code=s.material_code
 WHERE (:gea_p8 IS NULL OR COALESCE(n.category,'未分类')=:gea_p8)
 AND (:gea_p12 IS NULL OR b.material_code LIKE :gea_p12 OR b.material_name LIKE :gea_p12)
), batch_groups AS (
 SELECT CASE WHEN :gea_p9='base' THEN b.belong_base WHEN :gea_p9='category' THEN b.product_categ_name ELSE b.material_code END AS level,
 CASE WHEN :gea_p9='detail' THEN b.warehouseid ELSE NULL END AS warehouseid,
 CASE WHEN :gea_p9 IN ('sku','detail') THEN b.material_code ELSE NULL END AS material_code,
 CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT b.belong_base)=1 THEN MAX(b.belong_base) ELSE NULL END AS belong_base,
 CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT b.warehouse_name)=1 THEN MAX(b.warehouse_name) ELSE NULL END AS warehouse_name,
 CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT b.material_name)=1 THEN MAX(b.material_name) ELSE NULL END AS material_name,
 CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT b.product_categ_name)=1 THEN MAX(b.product_categ_name) ELSE NULL END AS product_categ_name,
 CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT b.material_group_name)=1 THEN MAX(b.material_group_name) ELSE NULL END AS material_group_name,
 COUNT(*) AS row_count,COUNT(CASE WHEN b.age_weight_qty>0 THEN 1 ELSE NULL END) AS age_valid_count, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN b.overaged_qty>0 THEN b.material_code ELSE NULL END) AS is_overaged_sku_count, CAST(NULL AS INTEGER) AS is_low_stock_sku_count,CAST(NULL AS INTEGER) AS is_high_stock_sku_count,CAST(NULL AS INTEGER) AS conflicting_stock_flag_skus,CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR(255)) AS source_updated_at,COUNT(DISTINCT b.material_code) AS sku_count,
 SUM(b.available_qty) AS available_qty,SUM(b.pack_unit_qty) AS pack_unit_qty,SUM(b.freeze_qty) AS freeze_qty,CAST(:gea_p1 AS DATE) AS stat_date,MAX(b.max_age) AS age_days,SUM(b.total_qty) AS total_qty, SUM(b.age_weight_qty) AS age_weight_qty,SUM(b.weighted_age) AS weighted_age,
 SUM(b.unknown_age_qty) AS unknown_age_qty,MAX(b.max_age) AS max_age,
 CASE WHEN SUM(b.age_weight_qty)>0 THEN SUM(b.weighted_age)*1.0/SUM(b.age_weight_qty) ELSE NULL END AS average_age,
 SUM(b.age0_30) AS age0_30, SUM(b.age31_40) AS age31_40, SUM(b.age41_60) AS age41_60, SUM(b.age60_plus) AS age60_plus, SUM(b.age31_60) AS age31_60, SUM(b.age61_90) AS age61_90, SUM(b.age90_plus) AS age90_plus, SUM(b.age60_89) AS age60_89, SUM(b.age90_119) AS age90_119, SUM(b.overaged_qty) AS overaged_qty, SUM(b.stagnant_qty) AS stagnant_qty, SUM(b.risk_current) AS risk_current,
 SUM(b.daily_movement) AS daily_movement,SUM(b.future7) AS future7,SUM(b.future14) AS future14,
 SUM(b.projected_risk7) AS projected_risk7,SUM(b.projected_risk14) AS projected_risk14,
 CASE WHEN SUM(b.daily_movement)>0 THEN SUM(b.total_qty)*1.0/SUM(b.daily_movement) ELSE NULL END AS historical_turnover,
 CASE WHEN SUM(b.age_weight_qty)=0 THEN NULL WHEN SUM(b.stagnant_qty)>0 THEN '滞库' WHEN SUM(b.overaged_qty)>0 THEN '预警' ELSE '正常' END AS warning
 FROM batch_facts AS b
 GROUP BY CASE WHEN :gea_p9='base' THEN b.belong_base WHEN :gea_p9='category' THEN b.product_categ_name ELSE b.material_code END,
 CASE WHEN :gea_p9='detail' THEN b.warehouseid ELSE NULL END,
 CASE WHEN :gea_p9 IN ('sku','detail') THEN b.material_code ELSE NULL END
) SELECT COUNT(*) AS total FROM batch_groups AS g

batch-age.atomic.title: 批次货龄结构
batch-age.atomic.notes: 批次生产日期计算货龄；正库存有效批次数量加权，未知货龄单列，不用最大值冒充平均值。FIFO在仓库/SKU内扣近30日正向发货日均×窗口，按SKU截零后汇总。基地未来7/14日为新增跨60天风险，排除当前60+。全链未来7/14日为基地>60/分仓>=90的期末风险量。不以其他SKU库存或销量抵消。

request.sql:
WITH inventory_batch_dates AS (
SELECT b.warehouse_classify AS warehouse_classify, b.warehouseid AS warehouseid, b.material_code AS material_code,
 b.month_date AS month_date,
 b.warehouse_name AS warehouse_name, b.belong_base AS belong_base, b.material_name AS material_name,
 b.live_qty AS live_qty, b.available_qty AS available_qty,
 b.pack_unit_qty AS pack_unit_qty, b.freeze_qty AS freeze_qty,
 CAST(SUBSTRING(b.month_date, 1, 4) AS INTEGER) AS snapshot_year,
 CAST(SUBSTRING(b.month_date, 5, 2) AS INTEGER) AS snapshot_month,
 CAST(SUBSTRING(b.month_date, 7, 2) AS INTEGER) AS snapshot_day,
 CASE WHEN LENGTH(b.prod_date) >= 10 AND SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 5, 1) = '-' AND SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 8, 1) = '-' AND SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 1, 1) BETWEEN '0' AND '9' AND SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 2, 1) BETWEEN '0' AND '9' AND SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 3, 1) BETWEEN '0' AND '9' AND SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 4, 1) BETWEEN '0' AND '9' AND SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 6, 1) BETWEEN '0' AND '9' AND SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 7, 1) BETWEEN '0' AND '9' AND SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 9, 1) BETWEEN '0' AND '9' AND SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 10, 1) BETWEEN '0' AND '9' THEN CAST(SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 1, 4) AS INTEGER) ELSE NULL END AS production_year,
 CASE WHEN LENGTH(b.prod_date) >= 10 AND SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 5, 1) = '-' AND SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 8, 1) = '-' AND SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 1, 1) BETWEEN '0' AND '9' AND SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 2, 1) BETWEEN '0' AND '9' AND SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 3, 1) BETWEEN '0' AND '9' AND SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 4, 1) BETWEEN '0' AND '9' AND SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 6, 1) BETWEEN '0' AND '9' AND SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 7, 1) BETWEEN '0' AND '9' AND SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 9, 1) BETWEEN '0' AND '9' AND SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 10, 1) BETWEEN '0' AND '9' THEN CAST(SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 6, 2) AS INTEGER) ELSE NULL END AS production_month,
 CASE WHEN LENGTH(b.prod_date) >= 10 AND SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 5, 1) = '-' AND SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 8, 1) = '-' AND SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 1, 1) BETWEEN '0' AND '9' AND SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 2, 1) BETWEEN '0' AND '9' AND SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 3, 1) BETWEEN '0' AND '9' AND SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 4, 1) BETWEEN '0' AND '9' AND SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 6, 1) BETWEEN '0' AND '9' AND SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 7, 1) BETWEEN '0' AND '9' AND SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 9, 1) BETWEEN '0' AND '9' AND SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 10, 1) BETWEEN '0' AND '9' THEN CAST(SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 9, 2) AS INTEGER) ELSE NULL END AS production_day
FROM agents_scm_inventory_sku_data_d AS b
WHERE b.warehouse_classify IN ('01', '02', '20') AND b.month_date = REPLACE(CAST(:gea_p1 AS VARCHAR(10)), '-', '') AND (:gea_p2 = FALSE OR b.belong_base IN (:gea_p3)) AND (:gea_p4 IS NULL OR b.warehouseid = :gea_p4) AND (:gea_p5 IS NULL OR b.material_code = :gea_p5)
), inventory_batch_ages AS (
SELECT d.warehouse_classify AS warehouse_classify, d.warehouseid AS warehouseid, d.material_code AS material_code,
 d.month_date AS month_date,
 d.warehouse_name AS warehouse_name, d.belong_base AS belong_base, d.material_name AS material_name,
 d.live_qty AS live_qty, d.available_qty AS available_qty,
 d.pack_unit_qty AS pack_unit_qty, d.freeze_qty AS freeze_qty,
 CASE WHEN d.live_qty > 0 AND d.production_year > 0
 AND d.production_month BETWEEN 1 AND 12 AND d.production_day >= 1 AND d.production_day <= CASE WHEN d.production_month=2 THEN CASE WHEN (d.production_year-4*FLOOR(d.production_year/4.0)=0 AND (d.production_year-100*FLOOR(d.production_year/100.0)<>0 OR d.production_year-400*FLOOR(d.production_year/400.0)=0)) THEN 29 ELSE 28 END WHEN d.production_month IN (4,6,9,11) THEN 30 ELSE 31 END
 AND (365 * (d.snapshot_year - CASE WHEN d.snapshot_month <= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) + FLOOR((d.snapshot_year - CASE WHEN d.snapshot_month <= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / 4.0) - FLOOR((d.snapshot_year - CASE WHEN d.snapshot_month <= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / 100.0) + FLOOR((d.snapshot_year - CASE WHEN d.snapshot_month <= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / 400.0) + FLOOR((153 * (d.snapshot_month + CASE WHEN d.snapshot_month > 2 THEN -3 ELSE 9 END) + 2) / 5.0) + d.snapshot_day) >= (365 * (d.production_year - CASE WHEN d.production_month <= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) + FLOOR((d.production_year - CASE WHEN d.production_month <= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / 4.0) - FLOOR((d.production_year - CASE WHEN d.production_month <= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / 100.0) + FLOOR((d.production_year - CASE WHEN d.production_month <= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / 400.0) + FLOOR((153 * (d.production_month + CASE WHEN d.production_month > 2 THEN -3 ELSE 9 END) + 2) / 5.0) + d.production_day) THEN (365 * (d.snapshot_year - CASE WHEN d.snapshot_month <= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) + FLOOR((d.snapshot_year - CASE WHEN d.snapshot_month <= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / 4.0) - FLOOR((d.snapshot_year - CASE WHEN d.snapshot_month <= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / 100.0) + FLOOR((d.snapshot_year - CASE WHEN d.snapshot_month <= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / 400.0) + FLOOR((153 * (d.snapshot_month + CASE WHEN d.snapshot_month > 2 THEN -3 ELSE 9 END) + 2) / 5.0) + d.snapshot_day) - (365 * (d.production_year - CASE WHEN d.production_month <= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) + FLOOR((d.production_year - CASE WHEN d.production_month <= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / 4.0) - FLOOR((d.production_year - CASE WHEN d.production_month <= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / 100.0) + FLOOR((d.production_year - CASE WHEN d.production_month <= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / 400.0) + FLOOR((153 * (d.production_month + CASE WHEN d.production_month > 2 THEN -3 ELSE 9 END) + 2) / 5.0) + d.production_day) ELSE NULL END AS age_days
FROM inventory_batch_dates AS d
), batch_skus AS (
 SELECT a.month_date AS month_date, a.warehouseid AS warehouseid, a.material_code AS material_code,
 CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT NULLIF(TRIM(a.belong_base),''))=1 THEN MAX(NULLIF(TRIM(a.belong_base),'')) ELSE NULL END AS belong_base,
 CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT NULLIF(TRIM(a.warehouse_name),''))=1 THEN MAX(NULLIF(TRIM(a.warehouse_name),'')) ELSE NULL END AS warehouse_name,
 CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT NULLIF(TRIM(a.material_name),''))=1 THEN MAX(NULLIF(TRIM(a.material_name),'')) ELSE NULL END AS material_name,
 SUM(COALESCE(a.live_qty,0)) AS total_qty, SUM(COALESCE(a.available_qty,0)) AS available_qty, SUM(COALESCE(a.pack_unit_qty,0)) AS pack_unit_qty, SUM(COALESCE(a.freeze_qty,0)) AS freeze_qty,
 SUM(CASE WHEN a.age_days IS NOT NULL THEN a.live_qty ELSE 0 END) AS age_weight_qty,
 SUM(CASE WHEN a.age_days IS NOT NULL THEN a.live_qty*a.age_days ELSE 0 END) AS weighted_age,
 SUM(CASE WHEN a.live_qty>0 AND a.age_days IS NULL THEN a.live_qty ELSE 0 END) AS unknown_age_qty,
 MAX(a.age_days) AS max_age,
 SUM(CASE WHEN a.age_days BETWEEN 0 AND 30 THEN a.live_qty ELSE 0 END) AS age0_30,
 SUM(CASE WHEN a.age_days BETWEEN 31 AND 40 THEN a.live_qty ELSE 0 END) AS age31_40,
 SUM(CASE WHEN a.age_days BETWEEN 41 AND 60 THEN a.live_qty ELSE 0 END) AS age41_60,
 SUM(CASE WHEN a.age_days > 60 THEN a.live_qty ELSE 0 END) AS age60_plus,
 SUM(CASE WHEN a.age_days > 30 AND a.age_days <= 60 THEN a.live_qty ELSE 0 END) AS age31_60,
 SUM(CASE WHEN a.age_days > 60 AND a.age_days <= 90 THEN a.live_qty ELSE 0 END) AS age61_90,
 SUM(CASE WHEN a.age_days > 90 THEN a.live_qty ELSE 0 END) AS age90_plus,
 SUM(CASE WHEN a.age_days >= 60 AND a.age_days < 90 THEN a.live_qty ELSE 0 END) AS age60_89,
 SUM(CASE WHEN a.age_days >= 90 AND a.age_days < 120 THEN a.live_qty ELSE 0 END) AS age90_119,
 SUM(CASE WHEN a.age_days >= 60 THEN a.live_qty ELSE 0 END) AS overaged_qty,
 SUM(CASE WHEN a.age_days >= 90 THEN a.live_qty ELSE 0 END) AS stagnant_qty,
 SUM(CASE WHEN a.age_days >= 53 THEN a.live_qty ELSE 0 END) AS future7_candidates,
 SUM(CASE WHEN a.age_days >= 46 THEN a.live_qty ELSE 0 END) AS future14_candidates,
 SUM(CASE WHEN (a.warehouse_classify IN ('01','02') AND a.age_days > 60) OR (a.warehouse_classify = '20' AND a.age_days >= 90) THEN a.live_qty ELSE 0 END) AS risk_current,
 SUM(CASE WHEN (a.warehouse_classify IN ('01','02') AND a.age_days > 53) OR (a.warehouse_classify = '20' AND a.age_days >= 83) THEN a.live_qty ELSE 0 END) AS risk7_candidates,
 SUM(CASE WHEN (a.warehouse_classify IN ('01','02') AND a.age_days > 46) OR (a.warehouse_classify = '20' AND a.age_days >= 76) THEN a.live_qty ELSE 0 END) AS risk14_candidates
 FROM inventory_batch_ages AS a GROUP BY a.month_date,a.warehouseid,a.material_code
), batch_names AS (
 SELECT n.warehouseid AS warehouseid,n.material_code AS material_code,
 CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT NULLIF(TRIM(n.product_categ_name),''))=1 THEN MAX(NULLIF(TRIM(n.product_categ_name),'')) ELSE NULL END AS category,
 CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT NULLIF(TRIM(n.material_group_name),''))=1 THEN MAX(NULLIF(TRIM(n.material_group_name),'')) ELSE NULL END AS material_group
 FROM agents_scm_material_in_out_summary_d AS n
 INNER JOIN batch_skus AS b ON b.warehouseid=n.warehouseid AND b.material_code=n.material_code
 GROUP BY n.warehouseid,n.material_code
), batch_sales AS (
 SELECT s.warehouse AS warehouseid,s.material_code AS material_code,
 SUM(CASE WHEN s.act_dl_qty>0 THEN s.act_dl_qty ELSE 0 END)/30.0 AS daily_movement
 FROM agents_scm_cust_deliv_daily_di AS s
 WHERE s.act_ship_date>=:gea_p6 AND s.act_ship_date<:gea_p7
 AND (:gea_p4 IS NULL OR s.warehouse=:gea_p4) AND (:gea_p5 IS NULL OR s.material_code=:gea_p5)
 GROUP BY s.warehouse,s.material_code
), batch_facts AS (
 SELECT b.warehouseid AS warehouseid,b.belong_base AS belong_base,b.warehouse_name AS warehouse_name,
 b.material_code AS material_code,b.material_name AS material_name,
 COALESCE(n.category,'未分类') AS product_categ_name,n.material_group AS material_group_name,
 b.available_qty AS available_qty,b.pack_unit_qty AS pack_unit_qty,b.freeze_qty AS freeze_qty,b.total_qty AS total_qty,b.age_weight_qty AS age_weight_qty,b.weighted_age AS weighted_age,
 b.unknown_age_qty AS unknown_age_qty,b.max_age AS max_age,
 b.age0_30 AS age0_30, b.age31_40 AS age31_40, b.age41_60 AS age41_60, b.age60_plus AS age60_plus, b.age31_60 AS age31_60, b.age61_90 AS age61_90, b.age90_plus AS age90_plus, b.age60_89 AS age60_89, b.age90_119 AS age90_119, b.overaged_qty AS overaged_qty, b.stagnant_qty AS stagnant_qty, b.risk_current AS risk_current,
 COALESCE(s.daily_movement,0) AS daily_movement,
 (CASE WHEN b.future7_candidates-7*COALESCE(s.daily_movement,0) > 0 THEN b.future7_candidates-7*COALESCE(s.daily_movement,0) ELSE 0 END)-(CASE WHEN b.age60_plus-7*COALESCE(s.daily_movement,0) > 0 THEN b.age60_plus-7*COALESCE(s.daily_movement,0) ELSE 0 END) AS future7,
 (CASE WHEN b.future14_candidates-14*COALESCE(s.daily_movement,0) > 0 THEN b.future14_candidates-14*COALESCE(s.daily_movement,0) ELSE 0 END)-(CASE WHEN b.age60_plus-14*COALESCE(s.daily_movement,0) > 0 THEN b.age60_plus-14*COALESCE(s.daily_movement,0) ELSE 0 END) AS future14,
 (CASE WHEN b.risk7_candidates-7*COALESCE(s.daily_movement,0) > 0 THEN b.risk7_candidates-7*COALESCE(s.daily_movement,0) ELSE 0 END) AS projected_risk7,
 (CASE WHEN b.risk14_candidates-14*COALESCE(s.daily_movement,0) > 0 THEN b.risk14_candidates-14*COALESCE(s.daily_movement,0) ELSE 0 END) AS projected_risk14
 FROM batch_skus AS b LEFT JOIN batch_names AS n ON b.warehouseid=n.warehouseid AND b.material_code=n.material_code
 LEFT JOIN batch_sales AS s ON b.warehouseid=s.warehouseid AND b.material_code=s.material_code
 WHERE (:gea_p8 IS NULL OR COALESCE(n.category,'未分类')=:gea_p8)
 AND (:gea_p12 IS NULL OR b.material_code LIKE :gea_p12 OR b.material_name LIKE :gea_p12)
), batch_groups AS (
 SELECT CASE WHEN :gea_p9='base' THEN b.belong_base WHEN :gea_p9='category' THEN b.product_categ_name ELSE b.material_code END AS level,
 CASE WHEN :gea_p9='detail' THEN b.warehouseid ELSE NULL END AS warehouseid,
 CASE WHEN :gea_p9 IN ('sku','detail') THEN b.material_code ELSE NULL END AS material_code,
 CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT b.belong_base)=1 THEN MAX(b.belong_base) ELSE NULL END AS belong_base,
 CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT b.warehouse_name)=1 THEN MAX(b.warehouse_name) ELSE NULL END AS warehouse_name,
 CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT b.material_name)=1 THEN MAX(b.material_name) ELSE NULL END AS material_name,
 CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT b.product_categ_name)=1 THEN MAX(b.product_categ_name) ELSE NULL END AS product_categ_name,
 CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT b.material_group_name)=1 THEN MAX(b.material_group_name) ELSE NULL END AS material_group_name,
 COUNT(*) AS row_count,COUNT(CASE WHEN b.age_weight_qty>0 THEN 1 ELSE NULL END) AS age_valid_count, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN b.overaged_qty>0 THEN b.material_code ELSE NULL END) AS is_overaged_sku_count, CAST(NULL AS INTEGER) AS is_low_stock_sku_count,CAST(NULL AS INTEGER) AS is_high_stock_sku_count,CAST(NULL AS INTEGER) AS conflicting_stock_flag_skus,CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR(255)) AS source_updated_at,COUNT(DISTINCT b.material_code) AS sku_count,
 SUM(b.available_qty) AS available_qty,SUM(b.pack_unit_qty) AS pack_unit_qty,SUM(b.freeze_qty) AS freeze_qty,CAST(:gea_p1 AS DATE) AS stat_date,MAX(b.max_age) AS age_days,SUM(b.total_qty) AS total_qty, SUM(b.age_weight_qty) AS age_weight_qty,SUM(b.weighted_age) AS weighted_age,
 SUM(b.unknown_age_qty) AS unknown_age_qty,MAX(b.max_age) AS max_age,
 CASE WHEN SUM(b.age_weight_qty)>0 THEN SUM(b.weighted_age)*1.0/SUM(b.age_weight_qty) ELSE NULL END AS average_age,
 SUM(b.age0_30) AS age0_30, SUM(b.age31_40) AS age31_40, SUM(b.age41_60) AS age41_60, SUM(b.age60_plus) AS age60_plus, SUM(b.age31_60) AS age31_60, SUM(b.age61_90) AS age61_90, SUM(b.age90_plus) AS age90_plus, SUM(b.age60_89) AS age60_89, SUM(b.age90_119) AS age90_119, SUM(b.overaged_qty) AS overaged_qty, SUM(b.stagnant_qty) AS stagnant_qty, SUM(b.risk_current) AS risk_current,
 SUM(b.daily_movement) AS daily_movement,SUM(b.future7) AS future7,SUM(b.future14) AS future14,
 SUM(b.projected_risk7) AS projected_risk7,SUM(b.projected_risk14) AS projected_risk14,
 CASE WHEN SUM(b.daily_movement)>0 THEN SUM(b.total_qty)*1.0/SUM(b.daily_movement) ELSE NULL END AS historical_turnover,
 CASE WHEN SUM(b.age_weight_qty)=0 THEN NULL WHEN SUM(b.stagnant_qty)>0 THEN '滞库' WHEN SUM(b.overaged_qty)>0 THEN '预警' ELSE '正常' END AS warning
 FROM batch_facts AS b
 GROUP BY CASE WHEN :gea_p9='base' THEN b.belong_base WHEN :gea_p9='category' THEN b.product_categ_name ELSE b.material_code END,
 CASE WHEN :gea_p9='detail' THEN b.warehouseid ELSE NULL END,
 CASE WHEN :gea_p9 IN ('sku','detail') THEN b.material_code ELSE NULL END
), batch_page AS (SELECT g.row_count AS row_count, g.age_valid_count AS age_valid_count, g.is_overaged_sku_count AS is_overaged_sku_count, g.is_low_stock_sku_count AS is_low_stock_sku_count, g.is_high_stock_sku_count AS is_high_stock_sku_count, g.conflicting_stock_flag_skus AS conflicting_stock_flag_skus, g.source_updated_at AS source_updated_at, g.available_qty AS available_qty, g.pack_unit_qty AS pack_unit_qty, g.freeze_qty AS freeze_qty, g.stat_date AS stat_date, g.age_days AS age_days, g.level AS level, g.warehouseid AS warehouseid, g.material_code AS material_code, g.belong_base AS belong_base, g.warehouse_name AS warehouse_name, g.material_name AS material_name, g.product_categ_name AS product_categ_name, g.material_group_name AS material_group_name, g.sku_count AS sku_count, g.total_qty AS total_qty, g.age_weight_qty AS age_weight_qty, g.weighted_age AS weighted_age, g.unknown_age_qty AS unknown_age_qty, g.max_age AS max_age, g.average_age AS average_age, g.age0_30 AS age0_30, g.age31_40 AS age31_40, g.age41_60 AS age41_60, g.age60_plus AS age60_plus, g.age31_60 AS age31_60, g.age61_90 AS age61_90, g.age90_plus AS age90_plus, g.age60_89 AS age60_89, g.age90_119 AS age90_119, g.overaged_qty AS overaged_qty, g.stagnant_qty AS stagnant_qty, g.risk_current AS risk_current, g.daily_movement AS daily_movement, g.future7 AS future7, g.future14 AS future14, g.projected_risk7 AS projected_risk7, g.projected_risk14 AS projected_risk14, g.historical_turnover AS historical_turnover, g.warning AS warning, 1 AS page_row_present FROM batch_groups AS g ORDER BY CASE WHEN :gea_p13='total_qty' AND :gea_p14='asc' THEN g.total_qty ELSE NULL END ASC, CASE WHEN :gea_p13='total_qty' AND :gea_p14='desc' THEN g.total_qty ELSE NULL END DESC, CASE WHEN :gea_p13='age60_plus' AND :gea_p14='asc' THEN g.age60_plus ELSE NULL END ASC, CASE WHEN :gea_p13='age60_plus' AND :gea_p14='desc' THEN g.age60_plus ELSE NULL END DESC, CASE WHEN :gea_p13='average_age' AND :gea_p14='asc' THEN g.average_age ELSE NULL END ASC, CASE WHEN :gea_p13='average_age' AND :gea_p14='desc' THEN g.average_age ELSE NULL END DESC, CASE WHEN :gea_p13='daily_movement' AND :gea_p14='asc' THEN g.daily_movement ELSE NULL END ASC, CASE WHEN :gea_p13='daily_movement' AND :gea_p14='desc' THEN g.daily_movement ELSE NULL END DESC, g.level,g.warehouseid,g.material_code LIMIT :gea_p10 OFFSET :gea_p11), batch_count AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS page_scope_total FROM batch_groups AS g) SELECT p.row_count AS row_count, p.age_valid_count AS age_valid_count, p.is_overaged_sku_count AS is_overaged_sku_count, p.is_low_stock_sku_count AS is_low_stock_sku_count, p.is_high_stock_sku_count AS is_high_stock_sku_count, p.conflicting_stock_flag_skus AS conflicting_stock_flag_skus, p.source_updated_at AS source_updated_at, p.available_qty AS available_qty, p.pack_unit_qty AS pack_unit_qty, p.freeze_qty AS freeze_qty, p.stat_date AS stat_date, p.age_days AS age_days, p.level AS level, p.warehouseid AS warehouseid, p.material_code AS material_code, p.belong_base AS belong_base, p.warehouse_name AS warehouse_name, p.material_name AS material_name, p.product_categ_name AS product_categ_name, p.material_group_name AS material_group_name, p.sku_count AS sku_count, p.total_qty AS total_qty, p.age_weight_qty AS age_weight_qty, p.weighted_age AS weighted_age, p.unknown_age_qty AS unknown_age_qty, p.max_age AS max_age, p.average_age AS average_age, p.age0_30 AS age0_30, p.age31_40 AS age31_40, p.age41_60 AS age41_60, p.age60_plus AS age60_plus, p.age31_60 AS age31_60, p.age61_90 AS age61_90, p.age90_plus AS age90_plus, p.age60_89 AS age60_89, p.age90_119 AS age90_119, p.overaged_qty AS overaged_qty, p.stagnant_qty AS stagnant_qty, p.risk_current AS risk_current, p.daily_movement AS daily_movement, p.future7 AS future7, p.future14 AS future14, p.projected_risk7 AS projected_risk7, p.projected_risk14 AS projected_risk14, p.historical_turnover AS historical_turnover, p.warning AS warning, p.page_row_present AS page_row_present,c.page_scope_total AS page_scope_total FROM batch_count AS c LEFT JOIN batch_page AS p ON 1=1 ORDER BY CASE WHEN :gea_p13='total_qty' AND :gea_p14='asc' THEN p.total_qty ELSE NULL END ASC, CASE WHEN :gea_p13='total_qty' AND :gea_p14='desc' THEN p.total_qty ELSE NULL END DESC, CASE WHEN :gea_p13='age60_plus' AND p.average_age ELSE NULL END ASC, CASE WHEN :gea_p13='average_age' AND :gea_p14='desc' THEN p.average_age ELSE NULL END DESC, CASE WHEN :gea_p13='daily_movement' AND :gea_p14='asc' THEN branch-health.summary.title: 源库存健康度全范围汇总
branch-health.summary.notes: 按统计日/基地/仓库类型/仓库编码/SKU读取；同键重复保留NULL。total_qty用于仓库库存范围；current_stock、target_stock_qty为跨仓重复的基地SKU参考值，不逐仓相加。货龄采用同记录total_qty加权，不推演批次。 批次现库存按仓库/SKU求和；不按 warehouse_classify 过滤或归类；分仓用 warehouseid 编码关联和筛选、warehouse_name 展示名称；基地用 belong_base 名称关联和筛选；商品名称取 material_name；基地与分仓为同一事实集的维度，不重复相加；正库存且生产日期有效的批次计算最大货龄。按原分仓规则逐批次汇总60天及以上超龄库存、90天及以上滞库库存；非正库存或无有效货龄的批次数量不计入风险量。安全/目标库存及更新时间仍保持未知。

branch-health.groups.title: 源库存健康度分层汇总分页
branch-health.groups.notes: 按统计日/基地/仓库类型/仓库编码/SKU读取；同键重复保留NULL。total_qty用于仓库库存范围；current_stock、target_stock_qty为跨仓重复的基地SKU参考值，不逐仓相加。货龄采用同记录total_qty加权，不推演批次。 批次现库存按仓库/SKU求和；不按 warehouse_classify 过滤或归类；分仓用 warehouseid 编码关联和筛选、warehouse_name 展示名称；基地用 belong_base 名称关联和筛选；商品名称取 material_name；基地与分仓为同一事实集的维度，不重复相加；正库存且生产日期有效的批次计算最大货龄。按原分仓规则逐批次汇总60天及以上超龄库存、90天及以上滞库库存；非正库存或无有效货龄的批次数量不计入风险量。安全/目标库存及更新时间仍保持未知。

request.sql:
WITH inventory_batch_dates AS (
SELECT b.warehouseid AS warehouseid, b.material_code AS material_code,
 b.month_date AS month_date,
 b.warehouse_name AS warehouse_name, b.belong_base AS belong_base, b.material_name AS material_name,
 b.live_qty AS live_qty, b.available_qty AS available_qty,
 b.pack_unit_qty AS pack_unit_qty, b.freeze_qty AS freeze_qty,
 CAST(SUBSTRING(b.month_date, 1, 4) AS INTEGER) AS snapshot_year,
 CAST(SUBSTRING(b.month_date, 5, 2) AS INTEGER) AS snapshot_month,
 CAST(SUBSTRING(b.month_date, 7, 2) AS INTEGER) AS snapshot_day,
 CASE WHEN LENGTH(b.prod_date) >= 10 AND SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 5, 1) = '-' AND SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 8, 1) = '-' AND SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 1, 1) BETWEEN '0' AND '9' AND SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 2, 1) BETWEEN '0' AND '9' AND SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 3, 1) BETWEEN '0' AND '9' AND SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 4, 1) BETWEEN '0' AND '9' AND SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 6, 1) BETWEEN '0' AND '9' AND SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 7, 1) BETWEEN '0' AND '9' AND SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 9, 1) BETWEEN '0' AND '9' AND SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 10, 1) BETWEEN '0' AND '9' THEN CAST(SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 1, 4) AS INTEGER) ELSE NULL END AS production_year,
 CASE WHEN LENGTH(b.prod_date) >= 10 AND SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 5, 1) = '-' AND SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 8, 1) = '-' AND SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 1, 1) BETWEEN '0' AND '9' AND SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 2, 1) BETWEEN '0' AND '9' AND SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 3, 1) BETWEEN '0' AND '9' AND SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 4, 1) BETWEEN '0' AND '9' AND SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 6, 1) BETWEEN '0' AND '9' AND SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 7, 1) BETWEEN '0' AND '9' AND SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 9, 1) BETWEEN '0' AND '9' AND SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 10, 1) BETWEEN '0' AND '9' THEN CAST(SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 6, 2) AS INTEGER) ELSE NULL END AS production_month,
 CASE WHEN LENGTH(b.prod_date) >= 10 AND SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 5, 1) = '-' AND SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 8, 1) = '-' AND SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 1, 1) BETWEEN '0' AND '9' AND SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 2, 1) BETWEEN '0' AND '9' AND SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 3, 1) BETWEEN '0' AND '9' AND SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 4, 1) BETWEEN '0' AND '9' AND SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 6, 1) BETWEEN '0' AND '9' AND SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 7, 1) BETWEEN '0' AND '9' AND SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 9, 1) BETWEEN '0' AND '9' AND SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 10, 1) BETWEEN '0' AND '9' THEN CAST(SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 9, 2) AS INTEGER) ELSE NULL END AS production_day
FROM agents_scm_inventory_sku_data_d AS b
WHERE b.warehouse_classify = '20' AND b.month_date = REPLACE(CAST(:gea_p1 AS VARCHAR(10)), '-', '')
), inventory_batch_ages AS (
SELECT d.warehouseid AS warehouseid, d.material_code AS material_code,
 d.month_date AS month_date,
 d.warehouse_name AS warehouse_name, d.belong_base AS belong_base, d.material_name AS material_name,
 d.live_qty AS live_qty, d.available_qty AS available_qty,
 d.pack_unit_qty AS pack_unit_qty, d.freeze_qty AS freeze_qty,
 CASE WHEN d.live_qty > 0 AND d.production_year > 0
 AND d.production_month BETWEEN 1 AND 12 AND d.production_day BETWEEN 1 AND 31
 AND (365 * (d.snapshot_year - CASE WHEN d.snapshot_month <= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) + FLOOR((d.snapshot_year - CASE WHEN d.snapshot_month <= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / 4.0) - FLOOR((d.snapshot_year - CASE WHEN d.snapshot_month <= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / 100.0) + FLOOR((d.snapshot_year - CASE WHEN d.snapshot_month <= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / 400.0) + FLOOR((153 * (d.snapshot_month + CASE WHEN d.snapshot_month > 2 THEN -3 ELSE 9 END) + 2) / 5.0) + d.snapshot_day) >= (365 * (d.production_year - CASE WHEN d.production_month <= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) + FLOOR((d.production_year - CASE WHEN d.production_month <= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / 4.0) - FLOOR((d.production_year - CASE WHEN d.production_month <= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / 100.0) + FLOOR((d.production_year - CASE WHEN d.production_month <= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / 400.0) + FLOOR((153 * (d.production_month + CASE WHEN d.production_month > 2 THEN -3 ELSE 9 END) + 2) / 5.0) + d.production_day) THEN (365 * (d.snapshot_year - CASE WHEN d.snapshot_month <= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) + FLOOR((d.snapshot_year - CASE WHEN d.snapshot_month <= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / 4.0) - FLOOR((d.snapshot_year - CASE WHEN d.snapshot_month <= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / 100.0) + FLOOR((d.snapshot_year - CASE WHEN d.snapshot_month <= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / 400.0) + FLOOR((153 * (d.snapshot_month + CASE WHEN d.snapshot_month > 2 THEN -3 ELSE 9 END) + 2) / 5.0) + d.snapshot_day) - (365 * (d.production_year - CASE WHEN d.production_month <= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) + FLOOR((d.production_year - CASE WHEN d.production_month <= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / 4.0) - FLOOR((d.production_year - CASE WHEN d.production_month <= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / 100.0) + FLOOR((d.production_year - CASE WHEN d.production_month <= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / 400.0) + FLOOR((153 * (d.production_month + CASE WHEN d.production_month > 2 THEN -3 ELSE 9 END) + 2) / 5.0) + d.production_day) ELSE NULL END AS age_days
FROM inventory_batch_dates AS d
), inventory_batch_totals AS (
SELECT CAST(CONCAT(SUBSTRING(a.month_date, 1, 4), '-', SUBSTRING(a.month_date, 5, 2), '-', SUBSTRING(a.month_date, 7, 2)) AS DATE) AS stat_date,
 a.warehouseid AS warehouseid, a.material_code AS material_code,
 CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT NULLIF(TRIM(a.warehouse_name), '')) = 1 THEN MAX(NULLIF(TRIM(a.warehouse_name), '')) ELSE NULL END AS warehouse_name,
 CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT NULLIF(TRIM(a.belong_base), '')) = 1 THEN MAX(NULLIF(TRIM(a.belong_base), '')) ELSE NULL END AS belong_base,
 CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT NULLIF(TRIM(a.material_name), '')) = 1 THEN MAX(NULLIF(TRIM(a.material_name), '')) ELSE NULL END AS material_name,
 SUM(COALESCE(a.live_qty, 0)) AS total_qty,

 SUM(COALESCE(a.pack_unit_qty, 0)) AS pack_unit_qty,
 SUM(COALESCE(a.freeze_qty, 0)) AS freeze_qty,
 MAX(a.age_days) AS age_days,
 SUM(CASE WHEN a.age_days >= 60 THEN a.live_qty ELSE 0 END) AS overaged_qty,
 SUM(CASE WHEN a.age_days >= 90 THEN a.live_qty ELSE 0 END) AS stagnant_qty
FROM inventory_batch_ages AS a
GROUP BY a.month_date, a.warehouseid, a.material_code
), inventory_batch_names AS (

), inventory_batch_source AS (

branch-health.options_count.title: 源库存健康度筛选选项数
branch-health.options_count.notes: 按统计日/基地/仓库类型/仓库编码/SKU读取；同键重复保留NULL。total_qty用于仓库库存范围；current_stock、target_stock_qty为跨仓重复的基地SKU参考值，不逐仓相加。货龄采用同记录total_qty加权，不推演批次。 批次现库存按仓库/SKU求和；不按 warehouse_classify 过滤或归类；分仓用 warehouseid 编码关联和筛选、warehouse_name 展示名称；基地用 belong_base 名称关联和筛选；商品名称取 material_name；基地与分仓为同一事实集的维度，不重复相加；正库存且生产日期有效的批次计算最大货龄。按原分仓规则逐批次汇总60天及以上超龄库存、90天及以上滞库库存；非正库存或无有效货龄的批次数量不计入风险量。安全/目标库存及更新时间仍保持未知。

 CASE WHEN LENGTH(b.prod_date) >= 10 AND SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 5, 1) = '-' AND SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 8, 1) = '-' AND SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 1, 1) BETWEEN '0' AND '9' AND SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 2, 1) BETWEEN '0' AND '9' AND SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 3, 1) BETWEEN '0' AND '9' AND SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 4, 1) BETWEEN '0' AND '9' AND SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 6, 1) BETWEEN '0' AND '9' AND SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 7, 1) BETWEEN '0' AND '9' AND SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 9, 1) BETWEEN '0' AND '9' AND SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 10, 1) BETWEEN '0' AND '9' THEN CAST(SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 6, 2) AS INTEGER) ELSE NULL END AS production_month,
 CASE WHEN LENGTH(b.prod_date) >= 10 AND SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 5, 1) = '-' AND SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 8, 1) = '-' AND SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 1, 1) BETWEEN '0' AND '9' AND SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 2, 1) BETWEEN '0' AND '9' AND SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 3, 1) BETWEEN '0' AND '9' AND SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 4, 1) BETWEEN '0' AND '9' AND SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 6, 1) BETWEEN '0' AND '9' AND SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 7, 1) BETWEEN '0' AND '9' AND SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 9, 1) BETWEEN '0' AND '9' AND SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 10, 1) BETWEEN '0' AND '9' THEN CAST(SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 9, 2) AS INTEGER) ELSE NULL END AS production_day

branch-health.detail.atomic.title: 源库存健康度明细分页
branch-health.detail.atomic.notes: 同一SQL读取总数及当前页；空页用一条标记行保留总数；外层显式保持原排序，不下载全量明细。；商品资料仅按唯一SKU匹配产品清单补空名称/物料组；同SKU字段冲突保留空，数量与日期范围不变。 批次现库存按仓库/SKU求和；不按 warehouse_classify 过滤或归类；分仓用 warehouseid 编码关联和筛选、warehouse_name 展示名称；基地用 belong_base 名称关联和筛选；商品名称取 material_name；基地与分仓为同一事实集的维度，不重复相加；正库存且生产日期有效的批次计算最大货龄。按原分仓规则逐批次汇总60天及以上超龄库存、90天及以上滞库库存；非正库存或无有效货龄的批次数量不计入风险量。安全/目标库存及更新时间仍保持未知。

location_type, CASE WHEN i.warehouse_classify = '20' THEN i.warehouseid ELSE i.belong_base END AS location_code, CASE WHEN i.warehouse_classify = '20' THEN i.warehouse_name ELSE i.belong_base END AS location_name FROM agents_scm_inventory_sku_data_d AS i INNER JOIN latest_inventory AS s ON i.month_date = s.month_date LEFT JOIN warehouse_points AS w ON i.warehouseid = w.warehouseid WHERE o.pickup_point = m.pickup_point WHERE o.bizflowstatus IN ('等待组波', '组波中', '组波完成', '组波失败', '提交成功', '提交中', '提交失败', '上传验证', '人工释放占用', '撤回待改单', '创建') AND (NOT m.pickup_point IS NULL OR NOT CONCAT('unmapped:', COALESCE(COALESCE(o.pickup_point, 'NULL'), '')) ELSE m.location_code END), fc_order_keys AS (SELECT o.location_type AS location_type, o.warehouseid AS warehouseid, o.material_code MAX(t.stat_month) ELSE NULL END AS stat_month, '分仓同步表' AS plan_source, CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL(20, 6)) AS warehouse_month_transfer_plan, COUNT(*) AS source_rows, CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = 1 THEN agents_scm_warehouse_transfer_plan_data_d AS t WHERE t.stat_month = SUBSTRING(REPLACE(CAST(:gea_p2300 AS VARCHAR(10)), '-', '') FROM 1 FOR 6) GROUP BY t.warehouse_code, t.material_code), + FLOOR((d.snapshot_year - CASE WHEN d.snapshot_month <= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / 4.0) - FLOOR((d.snapshot_year - CASE WHEN d.snapshot_month <= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / 100.0) + FLOOR((d.snapshot_year - CASE WHEN d.snapshot_month <= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / 400.0) + FLOOR((153 * (d.snapshot_month + CASE WHEN d.snapshot_month > 2 THEN -3 ELSE 9 END) + 2) / 5.0) + d.snapshot_day) >= (365 * (d.production_year - CASE WHEN d.production_month <= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) + FLOOR((d.production_year - CASE WHEN d.production_month <= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / 4.0) - FLOOR((d.production_year - CASE WHEN d.production_month <= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / 100.0) + FLOOR((d.production_year - CASE WHEN d.production_month <= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / 400.0) + FLOOR((153 * (d.production_month + CASE WHEN d.production_month > 2 THEN -3 ELSE 9 END) + 2) / 5.0) + d.production_day) THEN (365 * (d.snapshot_year - CASE WHEN d.snapshot_month <= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) + FLOOR((d.snapshot_year - CASE WHEN d.snapshot_month <= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / 4.0) - FLOOR((d.snapshot_year - CASE WHEN d.snapshot_month <= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / 100.0) + FLOOR((d.snapshot_year - CASE WHEN d.snapshot_month <= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / 400.0) + FLOOR((153 * (d.snapshot_month + CASE WHEN d.snapshot_month > 2 THEN -3 ELSE 9 END) + 2) / 5.0) + d.snapshot_day) - (365 * (d.production_year - CASE WHEN d.production_month <= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) + FLOOR((d.production_year - CASE WHEN d.production_month <= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / 4.0) - FLOOR((d.production_year - CASE WHEN d.production_month <= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / 100.0) + preparing, r.stat_month AS stat_month, r.plan_source AS plan_source, r.warehouse_month_transfer_plan AS warehouse_month_transfer_plan, r.month_ship_positive AS month_ship_positive, r.month_ship_net AS month_ship_net, r.rolling_ship_positive AS rolling_ship_positive, r.rolling_ship_daily AS rolling_ship_daily, r.last_ship_date AS last_ship_date, r.ship_source_rows AS ship_source_rows, r.plan_calculable AS plan_calculable, r.cycle_days AS cycle_days, r.calculation_status AS calculation_status, r.target_inventory_qty AS target_inventory_qty, r.recommended_qty AS recommended_qty, r.urgent AS urgent, r.historical_turnover_days AS historical_turnover_days, r.planned_daily_shipment AS planned_daily_shipment, r.remaining_outbound_qty AS remaining_outbound_qty, r.calculation_daily AS calculation_daily, r.forecast_turnover_days AS forecast_turnover_days, r.target_gap_qty AS target_gap_qty, r.safety_days AS safety_days, pp.current_out AS period_current_out, CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL(20, 6)) AS period_current_transfer, pp.next_out AS period_next_out, CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL(20, 6)) AS period_next_transfer, pp.current_source AS period_current_source, pp.next_source AS period_next_source, CASE WHEN pp.current_count > 1 THEN '同月计划冲突' WHEN pp.current_count = 1 AND pp.current_out >= 0 THEN '出货计划已同步；月调拨计划待接入' WHEN pp.current_count = 1 THEN '出货计划数量缺失或无效' ELSE '所选月份无出货计划' END AS period_plan_status, CASE WHEN op.source_order_count = 0 OR co.invalid_sku <> 0 THEN NULL ELSE COALESCE(co.demand_qty, 0) END AS current_order_demand, CASE WHEN op.source_order_count = 0 OR co.invalid_sku <> 0 THEN NULL ELSE COALESCE(co.allocated_qty, 0) END AS current_order_allocated, CASE WHEN op.source_order_count = 0 OR co.invalid_sku <> 0 THEN NULL ELSE COALESCE(co.remaining_qty, 0) END AS current_order_remaining, CASE WHEN op.source_order_count = 0 OR co.invalid_sku <> 0 THEN NULL ELSE COALESCE(co.shortage_qty, 0) END AS current_order_shortage, CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL(20, 6)) AS expected_month_end_qty, CASE WHEN pp.current_count <> 1 OR pp.current_out IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN pp.current_out - r.month_ship_positive > 0 THEN pp.current_out - r.month_ship_positive ELSE 0 END AS period_remaining_out, CASE WHEN pp.current_count = 1 AND pp.current_out >= 0 THEN CEIL(pp.current_out / CAST(:gea_p2301 AS DECIMAL(20, 6))) ELSE NULL END AS period_current_daily, CASE WHEN pp.next_count = 1 AND pp.next_out >= 0 THEN CEIL(pp.next_out / CAST(:gea_p2702 AS DECIMAL(20, 6))) ELSE NULL END AS period_next_daily, r.calculation_order_remaining AS calculation_order_remaining FROM filtered AS r LEFT JOIN fc_period_plans AS pp ON pp.warehouse_code = r.warehouse_code AND pp.sku = r.sku LEFT JOIN fc_current_orders AS co ON co.location_type = '分仓' AND co.warehouseid = r.warehouse_code AND co.material_code = r.sku CROSS JOIN fc_order_presence AS op WHERE r.recommended_qty > 0 ORDER BY r.recommended_qty DESC, r.warehouse_code, r.sku LIMIT :gea_p8 OFFSET :gea_p9

request.sql: WITH latest_inventory AS (SELECT MAX(agents_scm_inventory_sku_data_d.month_date) AS month_date FROM agents_scm_inventory_sku_data_d AS agents_scm_inventory_sku_data_d WHERE agents_scm_inventory_sku_data_d.warehouse_classify IN ('01', '02', '20')), warehouse_points AS (SELECT agents_scm_material_in_out_summary_d.warehouseid AS warehouseid, CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT NULLIF(TRIM(agents_scm_material_in_out_summary_d.pickup_point), '')) = 1 THEN MAX(NULLIF(TRIM(agents_scm_material_in_out_summary_d.pickup_point), '')) END AS pickup_point FROM agents_scm_material_in_out_summary_d AS agents_scm_material_in_out_summary_d GROUP BY agents_scm_material_in_out_summary_d.warehouseid), inventory_rows AS (SELECT i.warehouseid AS warehouseid, i.belong_base AS belong_base, i.material_code AS material_code, i.prod_date AS prod_date, i.sap_warehouseid AS sap_warehouseid, i.plant AS plant, i.quality_batch AS quality_batch, i.is_good_prod AS is_good_prod, i.warehouse_classify AS warehouse_classify, i.available_qty AS available_qty, w.pickup_point AS pickup_point, CASE WHEN i.warehouse_classify = '20' THEN '分仓' ELSE '基地' END AS location_type, CASE WHEN i.warehouse_classify = '20' THEN i.warehouseid ELSE i.belong_base END AS location_code, CASE WHEN i.warehouse_classify = '20' THEN i.warehouse_name ELSE i.belong_base END AS location_name FROM agents_scm_inventory_sku_data_d AS i INNER JOIN latest_inventory AS s ON i.month_date = s.month_date LEFT JOIN warehouse_points AS w ON i.warehouseid = w.warehouseid WHERE i.warehouse_classify IN ('01', '02', '20')), point_location_candidates AS (SELECT inventory_rows.pickup_point AS pickup_point, inventory_rows.location_type AS location_type, inventory_rows.location_code AS location_code, CASE WHEN inventory_rows.location_type = '分仓' THEN MAX(inventory_rows.warehouseid) END AS warehouseid, COUNT(DISTINCT inventory_rows.location_name) AS name_count, COUNT(DISTINCT inventory_rows.belong_base) AS base_count FROM inventory_rows AS inventory_rows WHERE NOT inventory_rows.pickup_point IS NULL AND NOT NULLIF(TRIM(inventory_rows.location_code), '') IS NULL GROUP BY inventory_rows.pickup_point, inventory_rows.location_type, inventory_rows.location_code), point_locations AS (SELECT point_location_candidates.pickup_point AS pickup_point, MAX(point_location_candidates.location_type) AS location_type, MAX(point_location_candidates.location_code) AS location_code, MAX(point_location_candidates.warehouseid) AS warehouseid FROM point_location_candidates AS point_location_candidates GROUP BY point_location_candidates.pickup_point HAVING COUNT(*) = 1 AND MAX(point_location_candidates.name_count) = 1 AND MAX(point_location_candidates.base_count) = 1), eligible_order_sku AS (SELECT o.material_code AS material_code, CASE WHEN m.pickup_point IS NULL THEN '待映射' ELSE m.location_type END AS location_type, CASE WHEN m.pickup_point IS NULL THEN CONCAT('unmapped:', COALESCE(COALESCE(o.pickup_point, 'NULL'), '')) ELSE m.location_code END AS location_code, MAX(m.warehouseid) AS warehouseid, CASE WHEN SUM(COALESCE(o.adjust_order_qty, 0)) - SUM(COALESCE(o.qtyallocated, 0)) > 0 THEN SUM(COALESCE(o.adjust_order_qty, 0)) - SUM(COALESCE(o.qtyallocated, 0)) ELSE 0 END AS remaining_qty, MAX(CASE WHEN m.pickup_point IS NULL OR NULLIF(TRIM(o.cust_order_no), '') IS NULL OR NULLIF(TRIM(o.material_code), '') IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS input_invalid FROM agents_scm_execute_detail_d AS o LEFT JOIN point_locations AS m ON o.pickup_point = m.pickup_point WHERE o.bizflowstatus IN ('等待组波', '组波中', '组波完成', '组波失败', '提交成功', '提交中', '提交失败', '上传验证', '人工释放占用', '撤回待改单', '创建') AND (NOT m.pickup_point IS NULL OR NOT NULLIF(TRIM(o.belong_base), '') IS NULL) GROUP BY o.cust_order_no, o.material_code, CASE WHEN m.pickup_point IS NULL THEN '待映射' ELSE m.location_type END, CASE WHEN m.pickup_point IS NULL THEN CONCAT('unmapped:', COALESCE(COALESCE(o.pickup_point, 'NULL'), '')) ELSE m.location_code END), fc_order_keys AS (SELECT o.location_type AS location_type, o.warehouseid AS warehouseid, o.material_code AS material_code FROM eligible_order_sku AS o GROUP BY o.location_type, o.warehouseid, o.material_code), source_records AS (SELECT t.warehouse_code AS warehouse_code, t.material_code AS material_code, CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = 1 THEN MAX(t.warehouse_name) ELSE NULL END AS warehouse_name, CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = 1 THEN MAX(t.material_name) ELSE NULL END AS material_name, CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = 1 THEN MAX(t.product_categ_name) ELSE NULL END AS product_categ_name, CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = 1 THEN MAX(t.warehouse_month_out_plan) ELSE NULL END AS warehouse_month_out_plan, CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = 1 THEN MAX(t.warehouse_transfer_qty) ELSE NULL END AS warehouse_transfer_qty, CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = 1 THEN MAX(t.transfer_onway_qty) ELSE NULL END AS transfer_onway_qty, CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = 1 THEN MAX(t.transfer_prepare_qty) ELSE NULL END AS transfer_prepare_qty, CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = 1 THEN MAX(t.stat_month) ELSE NULL END AS stat_month, COUNT(*) AS source_rows FROM agents_scm_warehouse_transfer_plan_data_d AS t WHERE t.stat_month = SUBSTRING(REPLACE(CAST(:gea_p2300 AS VARCHAR(10)), '-', ''), 1, 6) GROUP BY t.warehouse_code, t.material_code), branch_stock_keys AS (SELECT b.warehouseid AS warehouseid, b.material_code AS material_code FROM agents_scm_inventory_sku_data_d AS b WHERE b.warehouse_classify = '20' AND b.month_date = REPLACE(CAST(:gea_p2200 AS VARCHAR(10)), '-', '') GROUP BY b.warehouseid, b.material_code), source_keys AS (SELECT s.warehouse_code AS warehouse_code, s.material_code AS material_code FROM source_records AS s UNION ALL SELECT h.warehouseid AS warehouse_code, h.material_code AS material_code FROM branch_stock_keys AS h WHERE NOT NULLIF(TRIM(h.warehouseid), '') IS NULL UNION ALL SELECT co.warehouseid AS warehouse_code, co.material_code AS material_code FROM fc_order_keys AS co WHERE co.location_type = '分仓' AND NOT co.material_code IS NULL AND NOT co.warehouseid IS NULL), scope_keys AS (SELECT k.warehouse_code AS warehouse_code, k.material_code AS material_code FROM source_keys AS k GROUP BY k.warehouse_code, k.material_code), inventory_batch_dates AS (SELECT b.warehouseid AS warehouseid, b.material_code AS material_code, b.month_date AS month_date, b.warehouse_name AS warehouse_name, b.material_name AS material_name, b.available_qty AS available_qty FROM agents_scm_inventory_sku_data_d AS b WHERE b.warehouse_classify = '20' AND b.month_date = REPLACE(CAST(:gea_p2200 AS VARCHAR(10)), '-', '')), inventory_batch_ages AS (SELECT d.warehouseid AS warehouseid, d.material_code AS material_code, d.month_date AS month_date, d.warehouse_name AS warehouse_name, d.material_name AS material_name, d.available_qty AS available_qty FROM inventory_batch_dates AS d), inventory_batch_totals AS (SELECT CAST(CONCAT(COALESCE(SUBSTRING(a.month_date, 1, 4), ''), '-', COALESCE(SUBSTRING(a.month_date, 5, 2), ''), '-', COALESCE(SUBSTRING(a.month_date, 7, 2), '')) AS DATE) AS stat_date, a.warehouseid AS warehouseid, a.material_code AS material_code, CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT NULLIF(TRIM(a.warehouse_name), '')) = 1 THEN MAX(NULLIF(TRIM(a.warehouse_name), '')) ELSE NULL END AS warehouse_name, CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT NULLIF(TRIM(a.material_name), '')) = 1 THEN MAX(NULLIF(TRIM(a.material_name), '')) ELSE NULL END AS material_name, CASE WHEN COUNT(COALESCE(a.available_qty, 0)) = COUNT(*) THEN SUM(COALESCE(a.available_qty, 0)) ELSE NULL END AS available_qty FROM inventory_batch_ages AS a GROUP BY a.month_date, a.warehouseid, a.material_code), inventory_batch_names AS (SELECT n.warehouseid AS warehouseid, n.material_code AS material_code, CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT NULLIF(n.product_categ_name, '')) = 1 THEN MAX(NULLIF(n.product_categ_name, '')) ELSE NULL END AS product_categ_name, CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT NULLIF(n.material_group_name, '')) = 1 THEN MAX(NULLIF(n.material_group_name, '')) ELSE NULL END AS material_group_name FROM agents_scm_material_in_out_summary_d AS n GROUP BY n.warehouseid, n.material_code), inventory_batch_source AS (SELECT a.stat_date AS stat_date, a.warehouseid AS warehouseid, a.material_code AS material_code, COALESCE(a.warehouse_name, a.warehouseid) AS warehouse_name, a.material_name AS material_name, n.product_categ_name AS product_categ_name, n.material_group_name AS material_group_name, a.available_qty AS available_qty FROM inventory_batch_totals AS a LEFT JOIN inventory_batch_names AS n ON n.warehouseid = a.warehouseid AND n.material_code = a.material_code), branch_stock AS (SELECT t.stat_date AS stat_date, CASE WHEN COUNT(t.product_categ_name) = COUNT(*) AND COUNT(DISTINCT t.product_categ_name) = 1 THEN MAX(t.product_categ_name) ELSE NULL END AS product_categ_name, CASE WHEN COUNT(t.material_group_name) = COUNT(*) AND COUNT(DISTINCT t.material_group_name) = 1 THEN MAX(t.material_group_name) ELSE NULL END AS material_group_name, t.material_code AS material_code, t.warehouseid AS warehouseid, CASE WHEN COUNT(t.warehouse_name) = COUNT(*) AND COUNT(DISTINCT t.warehouse_name) = 1 THEN MAX(t.warehouse_name) ELSE NULL END AS warehouse_name, CASE WHEN COUNT(t.available_qty) = COUNT(*) AND COUNT(DISTINCT t.available_qty) = 1 THEN MAX(t.available_qty) ELSE NULL END AS available_qty, CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT NULLIF(TRIM(t.material_name), '')) = 1 THEN MAX(NULLIF(TRIM(t.material_name), '')) ELSE NULL END AS material_name FROM inventory_batch_source AS t WHERE t.stat_date = CAST(:gea_p2200 AS DATE) GROUP BY t.stat_date, t.warehouseid, t.material_code), branch_shipments AS (SELECT t.warehouse AS warehouse_code, t.material_code AS sku, CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT NULLIF(t.material_name, '')) = 1 THEN MAX(NULLIF(t.material_name, '')) ELSE NULL END AS material_name, CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT NULLIF(t.material_group_name, '')) = 1 THEN MAX(NULLIF(t.material_group_name, '')) ELSE NULL END AS material_group, CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT NULLIF(t.product_categ_name, '')) = 1 THEN MAX(NULLIF(t.product_categ_name, '')) ELSE NULL END AS category FROM agents_scm_cust_deliv_daily_di AS t WHERE t.warehouse_classify = '20' AND t.act_ship_date >= :gea_p2000 AND t.act_ship_date < :gea_p2001 GROUP BY t.warehouse, t.material_code), flow_names AS (SELECT t.warehouseid AS warehouse_code, t.material_code AS material_code, CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT NULLIF(TRIM(t.material_name), '')) = 1 THEN MAX(NULLIF(TRIM(t.material_name), '')) ELSE NULL END AS material_name, CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT NULLIF(TRIM(t.material_group_name), '')) = 1 THEN MAX(NULLIF(TRIM(t.material_group_name), '')) ELSE NULL END AS material_group FROM agents_scm_material_in_out_summary_d AS t GROUP BY t.warehouseid, t.material_code), product_list_dictionary AS (SELECT t.material_code AS sku, CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT NULLIF(TRIM(t.material_name), '')) = 1 THEN MAX(NULLIF(TRIM(t.material_name), '')) ELSE NULL END AS material_name, CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT NULLIF(TRIM(t.product_item_name), '')) = 1 THEN MAX(NULLIF(TRIM(t.product_item_name), '')) ELSE NULL END AS material_group FROM agents_dim_product_list_mi AS t WHERE NOT NULLIF(TRIM(t.material_code), '') IS NULL GROUP BY t.material_code), combined AS (SELECT k.warehouse_code AS warehouse_code, k.material_code AS sku, COALESCE(h.warehouse_name, s.warehouse_name) AS warehouse_name, COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(h.material_name), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(s.material_name), ''), sh.material_name, n.material_name)), ''), pm.material_name) AS material_name, COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(s.product_categ_name), ''), h.product_categ_name, sh.category) AS category, COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(COALESCE(sh.material_group, n.material_group, h.material_group_name)), ''), pm.material_group) AS material_group, h.available_qty AS available_qty, h.stat_date AS stock_date, s.warehouse_month_out_plan AS month_out_plan, CASE WHEN s.warehouse_transfer_qty >= 0 THEN s.warehouse_transfer_qty WHEN s.warehouse_transfer_qty IS NULL AND s.transfer_onway_qty >= 0 AND s.transfer_prepare_qty >= 0 THEN s.transfer_onway_qty + s.transfer_prepare_qty ELSE NULL END AS open_transfer_reported_qty, CASE WHEN s.stat_month = SUBSTRING(REPLACE(CAST(:gea_p2300 AS VARCHAR(10)), '-', ''), 1, 6) AND s.source_rows = 1 AND s.warehouse_month_out_plan >= 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS plan_calculable FROM scope_keys AS k LEFT JOIN source_records AS s ON (s.warehouse_code = k.warehouse_code OR (s.warehouse_code IS NULL AND k.warehouse_code IS NULL)) AND (s.material_code = k.material_code OR (s.material_code IS NULL AND k.material_code IS NULL)) LEFT JOIN branch_stock AS h ON h.warehouseid = k.warehouse_code AND h.material_code = k.material_code AND NOT NULLIF(TRIM(h.warehouseid), '') IS NULL LEFT JOIN branch_shipments AS sh ON sh.warehouse_code = k.warehouse_code AND sh.sku = k.material_code LEFT JOIN flow_names AS n ON n.warehouse_code = k.warehouse_code AND n.material_code = k.material_code LEFT JOIN product_list_dictionary AS pm ON pm.sku = k.material_code), location_sku_demand AS (SELECT eligible_order_sku.location_type AS location_type, eligible_order_sku.location_code AS location_code, eligible_order_sku.material_code AS material_code, MAX(eligible_order_sku.warehouseid) AS warehouseid, SUM(eligible_order_sku.remaining_qty) AS remaining_qty, MAX(eligible_order_sku.input_invalid) AS input_invalid FROM eligible_order_sku AS eligible_order_sku GROUP BY eligible_order_sku.location_type, eligible_order_sku.location_code, eligible_order_sku.material_code), complete_demand AS (SELECT location_sku_demand.location_type AS location_type, location_sku_demand.location_code AS location_code, location_sku_demand.material_code AS material_code, location_sku_demand.warehouseid AS warehouseid, location_sku_demand.remaining_qty AS remaining_qty, location_sku_demand.input_invalid AS input_invalid FROM location_sku_demand AS location_sku_demand UNION ALL SELECT l.location_type AS location_type, l.location_code AS location_code, CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR(255)) AS material_code, CASE WHEN l.location_type = '分仓' THEN MAX(l.warehouseid) END AS warehouseid, 0 AS remaining_qty, 0 AS input_invalid FROM inventory_rows AS l LEFT JOIN (SELECT location_sku_demand.location_type AS location_type, location_sku_demand.location_code AS location_code FROM location_sku_demand AS location_sku_demand GROUP BY location_sku_demand.location_type, location_sku_demand.location_code) AS d ON l.location_type = d.location_type AND l.location_code = d.location_code WHERE d.location_code IS NULL AND NOT NULLIF(TRIM(l.location_code), '') IS NULL GROUP BY l.location_type, l.location_code), inventory_batch AS (SELECT inventory_rows.location_type AS location_type, inventory_rows.location_code AS location_code, inventory_rows.material_code AS material_code, CASE WHEN COUNT(CASE WHEN COALESCE(inventory_rows.available_qty, 0) <> 0 THEN 1 END) > 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS duplicate_batch FROM inventory_rows AS inventory_rows GROUP BY inventory_rows.location_type, inventory_rows.location_code, inventory_rows.material_code, inventory_rows.warehouseid, inventory_rows.prod_date, inventory_rows.sap_warehouseid, inventory_rows.plant, inventory_rows.quality_batch, inventory_rows.is_good_prod, inventory_rows.warehouse_classify), inventory_sku AS (SELECT inventory_batch.location_type AS location_type, inventory_batch.location_code AS location_code, inventory_batch.material_code AS material_code, SUM(inventory_batch.duplicate_batch) AS duplicate_batch FROM inventory_batch AS inventory_batch GROUP BY inventory_batch.location_type, inventory_batch.location_code, inventory_batch.material_code), material_attributes AS (SELECT agents_scm_material_in_out_summary_d.material_code AS material_code FROM agents_scm_material_in_out_summary_d AS agents_scm_material_in_out_summary_d GROUP BY agents_scm_material_in_out_summary_d.material_code), fc_current_orders AS (SELECT d.location_type AS location_type, d.warehouseid AS warehouseid, d.material_code AS material_code, d.remaining_qty AS remaining_qty, CASE WHEN d.input_invalid <> 0 OR COALESCE(i.duplicate_batch, 0) <> 0 OR s.month_date IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS invalid_sku FROM complete_demand AS d CROSS JOIN latest_inventory AS s LEFT JOIN inventory_sku AS i ON d.location_type = i.location_type AND d.location_code = i.location_code AND d.material_code = i.material_code LEFT JOIN material_attributes AS a ON d.material_code = a.material_code), fc_order_presence AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS source_order_count FROM (SELECT 1 AS present FROM agents_scm_execute_detail_d AS probe_order LIMIT 1) AS order_probe), fc_net_input AS (SELECT r.warehouse_code AS warehouse_code, r.sku AS sku, r.warehouse_name AS warehouse_name, r.material_name AS material_name, r.category AS category, r.available_qty AS available_qty, r.open_transfer_reported_qty AS open_transfer_reported_qty, CASE WHEN r.plan_calculable = 1 THEN CEIL(r.month_out_plan / CAST(:gea_p2301 AS DECIMAL(20, 6))) ELSE NULL END AS fc_daily, CASE WHEN op.source_order_count = 0 OR co.invalid_sku <> 0 OR r.stock_date IS NULL OR REPLACE(CAST(r.stock_date AS VARCHAR(10)), '-', '') <> li.month_date THEN NULL ELSE COALESCE(co.remaining_qty, 0) END AS fc_remaining_orders, CASE WHEN ((:gea_p2900 = 'sku' AND :gea_p2901 = r.sku) OR (:gea_p2900 = 'material-group' AND :gea_p2901 = r.material_group) OR (:gea_p2900 = 'category' AND :gea_p2901 = r.category) OR (:gea_p2900 = 'warehouse' AND :gea_p2901 = r.warehouse_code)) AND (:gea_p2903 = '' OR :gea_p2903 <= :gea_p2801) AND (:gea_p2904 = '' OR :gea_p2904 >= :gea_p2801) THEN :gea_p2902 WHEN ((:gea_p2905 = 'sku' AND :gea_p2906 = r.sku) OR (:gea_p2905 = 'material-group' AND :gea_p2906 = r.material_group) OR (:gea_p2905 = 'category' AND :gea_p2906 = r.category) OR (:gea_p2905 = 'warehouse' AND :gea_p2906 = r.warehouse_code)) AND (:gea_p2908 = '' OR :gea_p2908 <= :gea_p2801) AND (:gea_p2909 = '' OR :gea_p2909 >= :gea_p2801) THEN :gea_p2907 WHEN ((:gea_p2910 = 'sku' AND :gea_p2911 = r.sku) OR (:gea_p2910 = 'material-group' AND :gea_p2911 = r.material_group) OR (:gea_p2910 = 'category' AND :gea_p2911 = r.category) OR (:gea_p2910 = 'warehouse' AND :gea_p2911 = r.warehouse_code)) AND (:gea_p2913 = '' OR :gea_p2913 <= :gea_p2801) AND (:gea_p2914 = '' OR :gea_p2914 >= :gea_p2801) THEN :gea_p2912 WHEN ((:gea_p2915 = 'sku' AND :gea_p2916 = r.sku) OR (:gea_p2915 = 'material-group'
